qe: The word 'Secular' was added to the Preamble to reflect which spirit of the Constitution?
qh: प्रस्तावना में 'धर्मनिरपेक्ष' शब्द संविधान की किस भावना को दर्शाने के लिए जोड़ा गया था?
o: Equal protection of all religions (सभी धर्मों का समान संरक्षण)
e: 'Secular' shabd 42nd samvidhan sanshodhan (1976) dwara Preamble mein joda gaya. Iska matlab ye nahi ki rajya dharm-viruddh hai ya dharmik shiksha par rok lagata hai; iska matlab hai ki rajya ka koi apna dharm nahi hota aur wo sabhi dharmon ko barabar samman aur samrakshan deta hai (positive secularism). Bharat ka secularism western model se alag hai - wahan church aur state bilkul alag hote hain, yahan rajya dharmik maamlon mein sudhaar ke liye hastakshep bhi kar sakta hai (jaise mandir pravesh, sati par rok). Aise hi Article 25-28 dharmik swatantra dete hain. Exam point: Secular = sabhi dharmon ka saman samman (42nd sanshodhan 1976 se juda hua).

qe: Which part of the Preamble ensures the 'Dignity of the Individual'?
qh: प्रस्तावना का कौन सा भाग 'व्यक्ति की गरिमा' सुनिश्चित करता है?
e: Preamble ka 'Fraternity' (bandhutva) wala vaada do cheezein dene ka vaada karta hai - vyakti ki garima (dignity of the individual) aur rashtra ki ekta tatha akhandata. Justice, Liberty aur Equality keval vyakti ke adhikar hain, lekin inka satat (long-lasting) rahna tabhi sambhav hai jab log aapas mein bhai-chare ke bhaav se jude hon. Isliye garima ka vishay fraternity se juda hai, aur yahi karan hai ki Article 51A (Fundamental Duties) mein bhi 'harmony aur common brotherhood' ka zikr hai. Exam point: Fraternity = vyakti ki garima + rashtra ki ekta aur akhandata (dono ek saath).

qe: The Preamble is called the 'Political Horoscope' of the Constitution by?
qh: प्रस्तावना को संविधान की 'राजनीतिक जन्मकुंडली' किसके द्वारा कहा गया है?
e: Preamble ko 'Political Horoscope' (rajnitik patrika/kundli) kehne ka shrey K.M. Munshi (Kanhaiyalal Maneklal Munshi) ko jaata hai, jo samvidhan sabha ke ek pramukh sadasya aur Drafting Committee ke member the. Unhone kaha tha ki Preamble samvidhan ki bhavishya ki disha aur uske ideal (adarsh) ko darpiyan (mirror) ki tarah dikhata hai, jaise kundli aage ka raasta batati hai. Isi tarah Palkhivala ne Preamble ko 'Identity Card', Ernest Barker ne 'Key-note' aur Thakurdas Bhargava ne 'Soul of the Constitution' kaha tha. Exam point: Political Horoscope = K.M. Munshi; Identity Card = N.A. Palkhivala; Key-note = Ernest Barker; Soul = Thakurdas Bhargava.

qe: The ideals of 'Liberty, Equality and Fraternity' are borrowed from?
qh: 'स्वतंत्रता, समानता और बंधुत्व' के आदर्श कहाँ से लिए गए हैं?
e: 'Liberty, Equality aur Fraternity' ke teeno aadarsh French Revolution (1789) se liye gaye hain, jiska nara tha 'Liberte, Egalite, Fraternite'. Isi tarah samvidhan ke andar 'Republic' ka vichar bhi France se aaya hai. Lekin saavdhan rahe - Preamble mein diye gaye 'Justice' (samajik, aarthik, rajnitik) ka srot Russian Revolution hai, aur Preamble ki bhasha (language/style) Australia ke samvidhan se prabhavit hai. American Revolution se hamne 'We the People' wali bhasha aur Bill of Rights ka vichar liya. Exam point: Liberty-Equality-Fraternity = French Revolution; Justice = Russian Revolution; Preamble ka bhasha-shaili = Australia.

qe: What is the correct sequence of keywords in the Preamble?
qh: प्रस्तावना में मुख्य शब्दों का सही क्रम क्या है?
e: Preamble mein mukhya shabdon ka sahi kram hai - Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, Republic. Iske baad aata hai 'Justice, social, economic and political', phir 'Liberty of thought, expression, belief, faith and worship', phir 'Equality of status and opportunity' aur ant mein 'Fraternity' tatha 'Unity and integrity of the Nation'. Ye kram hi samvidhan ki soch ka dhancha (structure) siddh kar deta hai: pehle rashtra ka swaroop, phir uske adarsh. Exam point: kram yaad rakho - Sovereign-Socialist-Secular-Democratic-Republic (aakhir mein Republic, kyunki Republic rashtra ka swarup batata hai).

qe: The Preamble was debated in the Constituent Assembly at the very end. Why?
qh: संविधान सभा में प्रस्तावना पर सबसे अंत में चर्चा क्यों की गई?
o: To ensure it matched the final Constitution (संविधान के अनुरूप सुनिश्चित करने के लिए)
e: Samvidhan sabha mein Preamble par bahas sabse ant mein (late) hui, kyunki vidhan-nirmata chahte the ki jo samvidhan ka poora dhancha aur uske saare ansh (articles) tay ho jaayen, uske baad hi Preamble likha jaaye taaki wo samvidhan ke anuroop (in conformity) ho. Isi liye 22 January 1947 ko Objective Resolution (uddeshya prastav) ke roop mein apnaya gaya tha, lekin uska antim roop 26 November 1949 ko apnaya gaya - ek din baad jab samvidhan apnaya gaya tha. Exam point: Preamble 'last mein' likha/apnaya gaya, taaki wo samvidhan ke saath poora mel khaaye.

qe: How many times has the Preamble been amended so far?
qh: अब तक प्रस्तावना में कितनी बार संशोधन किया गया है?
e: Bharat ke Preamble mein aaj tak keval ek baar (only once) sanshodhan hua hai - 42nd samvidhan sanshodhan adhiniyam 1976 dwara, jismein teen shabd jode gaye: Socialist, Secular aur Integrity. Iske alava 'unity of the Nation' ko badal kar 'unity and integrity of the Nation' banaya gaya. Berubari (1960) mein Court ne Preamble ko samvidhan ka hissa nahi maana tha, lekin Kesavananda Bharati (1973) ke baad yah maana jaata hai ki Preamble samvidhan ka hissa hai aur Article 368 ke antargat usmein sanshodhan ho sakta hai. Exam point: Preamble mein kul sanshodhan = 1 (42nd, 1976).

qe: The objective of 'Justice' in the Preamble is inspired by which Revolution?
qh: प्रस्तावना में 'न्याय' का उद्देश्य किस क्रांति से प्रेरित है?
e: Preamble ke 'Justice' (Social, Economic aur Political) ka aadarsh Russian Revolution (1917) se liya gaya hai. Us samay Russia mein samajik, aarthik aur rajnitik nyay ki maang zoron par thi, aur isi soch ne hamare samvidhan ke DPSP (Directive Principles of State Policy) ko bhi aakar diya. French Revolution se equality, liberty, fraternity aaye, aur Irish samvidhan se DPSP ka vichar aaya (Ireland ne khud Irish-Danish system se liya tha). Exam point: Preamble ka 'Justice' = Russian Revolution; DPSP ka vichar = Ireland; sudaar (samvidhan) mein Britain se kuchh procedural cheezein li gayi.

qe: Who described the Preamble as the 'Soul of the Constitution'?
qh: प्रस्तावना को 'संविधान की आत्मा' किसने कहा?
e: Thakurdas Bhargava ne Preamble ko 'Soul of the Constitution' (samvidhan ki aatma) kaha tha. 'Aatma' ka matlab hai wo andar ki cheez jo shareer ko jeevan deti hai - isi tarah Preamble samvidhan ke andar basi uski bhavana ko prastut karta hai. Iske saath unhi ne Preamble ko 'Jewel set in the Constitution' bhi kaha. Note ki B.R. Ambedkar ne Article 32 ko 'Heart and Soul of the Constitution' kaha tha - dono bayano ko confuse nahi karna chahiye. Exam point: Soul of Constitution = Thakurdas Bhargava (Preamble); Heart and Soul = B.R. Ambedkar (Article 32).

qe: The term 'Sovereign' implies that India can:
qh: 'संप्रभु' शब्द का अर्थ है कि भारत:
o: Acquire foreign territory (विदेशी क्षेत्र का अधिग्रहण कर सकता है)
e: 'Sovereign' (samprabhu) ka matlab hai Bharat kisi bhi bahri shakti (power) ke adheen nahi hai - na rajnitik, na aarthik. Isliye Bharat chaahe to apni niyati khud tay kar sakta hai, koi bhi naya kshetra apne mein mila (acquire) sakta hai (jaise Sikkim 1975) aur apna kshetra kisi doosre desh ko de bhi sakta hai (Berubari mein Court ne kaha tha ki parliament ko iske liye sanshodhan chahiye). Commonwealth ki membership ya UNO ki sadasyata sovereignty ke virodh nahi hai. Exam point: Sovereign = andar aur bahar dono jagah swatantra + kshetra lena ya dena dono ka adhikar.

qe: Which part of the Preamble is Non-Justiciable?
qh: प्रस्तावना का कौन सा भाग 'गैर-न्यायोचित' है?
e: Preamble ka poora hissa 'non-justiciable' hai - matlab ismein diye gaye adarsh (Justice, Liberty, Equality, Fraternity) kisi bhi court mein muqadma (case) daal kar lagu (enforce) nahi karaye ja sakte. Ye samvidhan ke nirmataon ki niyat, bhavana aur darshan ko prastut karta hai, kanooni hak nahi deta. Isi liye kisi vyakti ko court mein ye nahi kehne ka adhikar nahi ki 'Preamble ke anusaar mujhe nyay mila nahi, isliye sarkar par case chale'. Exam point: Preamble ka har shabd non-justiciable hai - sirf vyakhya (interpretation) ka saadhan hai.

qe: The phrase 'Equality of Status and Opportunity' refers to:
qh: 'प्रतिष्ठा और अवसर की समानता' का तात्पर्य है:
o: Removal of all discriminations (सभी भेदभावों को हटाना)
e: Preamble ka 'Equality of status and opportunity' hamare samvidhan ke Article 14 se 18 (Right to Equality) mein vistrata se diya gaya hai. Iska tatparya hai ki kisi bhi vyakti ke saath uske janm, dharm, ling, jaati, nasl ya jati ke aadhar par bhedbhav nahi hoga, aur sabhi ko zindagi mein aage badhne ka barabar avsar milega. Isi vichar se Article 15 (bhedbhav par rok), Article 16 (naukri mein barabari), Article 17 (chhuachhoot ka ant) aur Article 18 (upadhi ka ant) aate hain. Exam point: Equality of status and opportunity = Right to Equality, Article 14-18; ye Preamble aur Fundamental Rights dono mein hai.

qe: What was the status of India before 26 January 1950?
qh: 26 जनवरी 1950 से पहले भारत की स्थिति क्या थी?
e: 26 January 1950 se pehle Bharat ek 'Dominion' (doaminian) tha, matlab ek aisa rajya jo British Commonwealth ka ek aatma-sashit (self-governing) sadasya tha lekin poori tarah swatantra nahi. British Crown ka ek pratilipi (Governor-General) Bharat ka rashtra-adhyaksh hota tha aur British sansad ke kuchh kanoon yahan chalta the. 26 January 1950 ko samvidhan lagu hua, British shasan ka ant hua, aur Bharat ek samprabhu (Sovereign), loktantrik ganrajya (Democratic Republic) ban gaya; rashtra-adhyaksh (President) ab janata ke pratinidhi se chuna jaata hai. Exam point: 15 August 1947 = Dominion; 26 January 1950 = Sovereign Democratic Republic.

qe: The concept of 'Welfare State' is found in:
qh: 'कल्याणकारी राज्य' की अवधारणा कहाँ पाई जाती है?
o: Both Preamble and DPSP (प्रस्तावना और DPSP दोनों)
e: 'Welfare State' (kalyan rajya) ka vichar Preamble aur DPSP (Directive Principles of State Policy) dono mein milta hai. Preamble mein diye 'Justice, social, economic and political', 'Equality of status and opportunity' aur 'Fraternity' hi kalyan rajya ke adarsh hain, aur DPSP (Article 36-51) mein sarkar ko niti banaane ke liye nirdesh (directives) diye gaye hain, jaise Article 39 (samajik-adhidhan ka saman vitaran), Article 41 (kaam, shiksha, madad), Article 47 (poshan aur jeevan sthar badhana). Isliye kalyan rajya ka dhancha Preamble + DPSP ke mel se banta hai. Exam point: Welfare State = Preamble ke adarsh + DPSP ke nirdesh (dono).

qe: Which article of the Constitution is called the 'Spirit of the Preamble'?
qh: संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद को 'प्रस्तावना की भावना' कहा जाता है?
e: Article 38 (DPSP) ko Preamble ki 'aatma' ya 'Spirit of the Preamble' kaha jaata hai kyunki ye sarkar ko nirdesh deta hai ki wo aisi samajik vyavastha banaye jismein nyay, samajik, aarthik aur rajnitik - teeno prakar ka nyay jeevan ke har kshetra mein sthapit ho. Isi Article ke teht (2001, 44th sanshodhan dwara) sarkar ko aay, darj (status), sadhan (facilities) aur avsar ke antar (inequalities) ko kam karne ka aadesh bhi mila. Exam point: Article 38 = Preamble ka nyay-wala 'spirit'; DPSP ka pehla ahem nirdesh (samajik nyay ke liye niti).

qe: Economic Justice as per the Preamble means:
qh: प्रस्तावना के अनुसार 'आर्थिक न्याय' का अर्थ है:
o: Reducing gap between rich and poor (अमीर और गरीब के बीच की खाई को कम करना)
e: Preamble ka 'Economic Justice' ka matlab hai aarthik jan-jeevan mein nyay - matlab aay (income) aur sampatti mein itni badi khai (gap) na ho ki garib vyakti apni zindagi ki buniyadi zaruratein bhi pura na kar sake. Iske liye DPSP mein aay-kar, samajik-adhikar, nirasrit (nationalise) vyavastha aur zameen-darj sudhaar jaise upay sochh gaye hain. 'Free money' ya 'sabko barabar salary' jaise bolti bolna iska matlab nahi hai. Exam point: Economic Justice = amir-garib ki khai kam karna + sabko rozgaar aur aay ke awsar (Article 39 ke saath juda).

qe: The Preamble was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on which date?
qh: संविधान सभा द्वारा प्रस्तावना को किस तिथि को अपनाया गया था?
e: Samvidhan sabha ne Preamble ko 22 January 1947 ko 'Objective Resolution' ke roop mein sweekar kiya tha - isi liye yahi us din ki tareekh Preamble mein chhapti hai jab asli uddeshya (adopted by the Constituent Assembly) tay hua tha. 26 November 1949 ko samvidhan apnayaaya gaya (us din Preamble ka final language bhi tay hua) aur 26 January 1950 se samvidhan lagu (came into force) hua. Kai examinon (pariksharthi) 26 Nov 1949 ko Preamble ki date samajh lete hain, lekin poochha jaaye to Preamble mein likhi tareekh 22 January 1947 hi hai. Exam point: Preamble ki tareekh = 22 January 1947; samvidhan adopt = 26 Nov 1949; lagu = 26 Jan 1950.

qe: Who called the Preamble the 'Keynote' to the Constitution?
qh: प्रस्तावना को संविधान का 'की-नोट' किसने कहा था?
e: Ernest Barker (British rajnitik vaigyanik) ne Preamble ko 'Key-note' (mool sur) kaha tha. Unka tark tha ki jaise sangeet mein har gAt ki surbhi (keynote) ko satyam mein pesh karta hai, waise hi Preamble samvidhan ke saare anshon ka mool sur hai - usmein hi rashtra ki niti aur adarsh ke saare surachi hote hain. Isi baat se similar bayan N.A. Palkhivala ne 'Identity Card', K.M. Munshi ne 'Political Horoscope' aur Thakurdas Bhargava ne 'Soul' wala diya. Exam point: Key-note = Ernest Barker; Identity Card = Palkhivala; Political Horoscope = Munshi; Soul = Bhargava.

qe: What does 'Fraternity' ensure apart from Dignity?
qh: 'बंधुत्व' गरिमा के अलावा और क्या सुनिश्चित करता है?
o: Unity and Integrity of the nation (राष्ट्र की एकता और अखंडता)
e: Preamble ka 'Fraternity' (bandhutva) keval 'sabhi log bhai hain' kehna nahi hai; ye do vaade deta hai - vyakti ki garima (dignity) surakshit rakhna aur rashtra ki ekta (unity) tatha akhandata (integrity) bachaye rakhna. Article 51A (Fundamental Duties) isi bhavana ko aage badhata hai jahan nagrikon ko 'samrasta aur bhai-chaara' badhane aur 'rashtra ki ekta aur akhandata' ki raksha karne ka farz diya gaya hai. Isi tarah 'Fraternity' jevI cheezein national integration ke liye hai, isliye iska jawab sirf property ya free speech nahi ho sakta. Exam point: Fraternity = dignity of individual + unity and integrity of nation (Article 51A se juda hua).

qe: The word 'Socialist' in our Constitution aims to:
qh: हमारे संविधान में 'समाजवादी' शब्द का लक्ष्य है:
o: End poverty and ignorance (गरीबी और अज्ञानता को समाप्त करना)
e: Preamble ka 'Socialist' shabd (42nd sanshodhan 1976 se joda gaya) batata hai ki Bharat ek samajwadi desh hai - par iska matlab private property ka ant nahi, balki garibi, bekarI, bimari aur agyanta (ignorance) ka ant hai aur aay-evam-sampatti mein saman vitran hai. Bharat ka model Democratic Socialism hai - matlab samajik lakshya democratic aur shaantipurn raahon se paane hain, kisi kranti ya ek-party shasan se nahi. Socialist, Communist, Samyavad sabhi shabd alag-alag arth rakhte hain; isliye sarkar apni niti mein garibi unmoolan (poverty removal) aur saman avsar ke liye kaam karti hai. Exam point: Socialist = garibi hataana + saman avsar (Democratic Socialism; private industry bilkul band nahi).

qe: The Preamble is the summary of which of the following?
qh: प्रस्तावना निम्नलिखित में से किसका सारांश है?
e: Preamble samvidhan ka saar (summary) hai kyunki usmein samvidhan ki buniyadi soch - rashtra ka Swaroop (sovereign socialist secular democratic republic), uske adarsh (justice, liberty, equality, fraternity) aur rashtra ki taaqat janata - sab kuch gunth (brief) kar diya gaya hai. Iske kaaran Preamble ko samvidhan ki 'talaash-nirdeshika' (guide) kehte hain, lekin wo kisi ek bhag (jaise keval DPSP ya Fundamental Rights) ka saar nahi, poore samvidhan ka saar hai. Exam point: Preamble = samvidhan ka saar (summary) + vyakhya karne ka aadhar (aid).

qe: Which of the following describes the Preamble correctly?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन प्रस्तावना का सही वर्णन करता है?
o: It is a legal document enforceable in court
It is an aid to interpret the Constitution (संविधान की व्याख्या में सहायक)
It is a source of legislative power
e: Preamble ka istemaal samvidhan ki vyakhya (interpretation) ke liye ek gaida (aid) ki tarah hota hai - jab koi Article ke ardh mein shak ho, to Court Preamble ke adarsh se madad leta hai. Lekin wo ek kanooni dastaavez (enforceable legal document) nahi hai: usmein koi adhikar nahi diya gaya, koi vidhaayak shakti (legislative power) uska srot nahi, aur court uske aadhar par kisi ko saza ya aadesh nahi de sakta. Isi liye 'None of these' wale vikalp hi sahi hain jab enforceability ki baat ho. Exam point: Preamble = aid to interpretation (vyakhya ka sahayak), na ki ek enforceable kanoon.

qe: In the phrase 'We, the People of India', who are 'The People'?
qh: 'हम, भारत के लोग' वाक्यांश में 'लोग' कौन हैं?
o: The entire Indian population (संपूर्ण भारतीय जनसंख्या)
e: 'We, the People of India' mein 'People' ka matlab poore Bharat ki janata (entire Indian population) hai - na sirf samvidhan sabha, na neta, na kisi party ke log. Isi pankti se chal kar Preamble ye ghosha karta hai ki samvidhan ki asli power (ultimate sovereignty) janata ke haath mein hai; isliye rashtra ki sarvochch raajnitik ikai (institution) bhi janata ke pratinidhiyon se chuni jaati hai. Yahi soch loktantra ka buniyadi aadhar hai - 'janata ke dwara chuni hui sarkar, janata ke liye'. Exam point: 'We the People' = janata hi samvidhan ka asli srot (authority ka ultimate source).

qe: The word 'Sovereign' makes India:
qh: 'संप्रभु' शब्द भारत को बनाता है:
o: Free from any foreign interference (किसी भी विदेशी हस्तक्षेप से मुक्त)
e: 'Sovereign' shabd Bharat ko aisa rashtra batata hai jo kisi bhi baahari shakti (foreign interference) se poori tarah mukt hai - na kisi bahari desh ki aagya chalti hai, na kisi upniveshik (colonial) bandhan mein bandha hua hai. Isliye Bharat apni kanoon, vyapar, raksha, videsh-niti aur aantarik vyavastha khud tay karta hai; wo Britain ka adheen, kisi mahashakti (superpower) ka colony ya sanyukt rashtra sangh (UN) ka adheen nahi hai. Commonwealth ki sadasyata ya antarrashtriya samjhauton par hastakshar karne se sovereignty khatam nahi hoti. Exam point: Sovereign = kisi bhi bahari hastakshep se mukt (aantarik aur bahari, dono tarah ki swatantrata).

qe: What type of 'Democracy' does the Preamble envision?
qh: प्रस्तावना किस प्रकार के 'लोकतंत्र' की कल्पना करती है?
e: Preamble ka 'Democratic' shabd batata hai ki Bharat mein loktantra (democracy) hoga, lekin hamara loktantra 'indirect' ya 'representative' (pratyaksh/pratinidhi) hai - matlab janata khud kanoon nahi banati, balki apne pratinidhi chun kar unke through kanoon banwaati hai. Direct democracy (jaise Switzerland ke referendum) ki kuchh jhalak Bharat mein Panchayat Raj aur Jan-Sunwai (sunwai), RTI jaisi vyavastha mein milti hai, par mukhya dhaara representative hai. Isi liye Preamble mein democracy ko political, social aur economic - teen roopon mein samjha gaya hai. Exam point: Bharat = indirect (representative) democracy; political + social + economic, teeno prakar ke loktantra ka lakshya.

qe: Equality of status and opportunity is detailed in which articles?
qh: स्थिति और अवसर की समानता का विवरण किन अनुच्छेदों में है?
e: Preamble ka 'Equality of status and opportunity' ko vistAAR (detail) samvidhan ke Article 14 se 18 tak diya gaya hai, jise 'Right to Equality' kehte hain. Article 14 kanoon ke samaksh samanta deta hai, Article 15 dharm, jaati, ling, janm-sthan ke aadhar par bhedbhav rokta hai, Article 16 sarkari naukri mein avsar ki barabari deta hai, Article 17 chhuachhoot par rok lagata hai aur Article 18 upadhi (title) laane par rok lagata hai. Article 12-13 keval 'rajya' aur 'kanoon' ki paribhasha batate hain, aur Article 19-22 swatantrata ke adhikar hain. Exam point: Equality of status and opportunity = Article 14-18 (Right to Equality).

qe: The date mentioned in the Preamble is:
qh: प्रस्तावना में उल्लेखित तिथि है:
e: Preamble mein likhi tareekh 26 November 1949 hai - yahi din samvidhan sabha ne samvidhan ko sweekar (adopt) kiya tha aur isi din Preamble ko antim roop diya gaya tha. Lekin samvidhan 26 January 1950 se lagu hua, isi liye us din ko ham 'Republic Day' ke roop mein manate hain (1950 se pehle 26 January 1930 ko purna swaraj diwas wale tak ke aadhar par). 15 August 1947 diwas swatantrata ka din hai, 2 October 1869 Gandhi ji ka janm-diwas hai, isliye ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Preamble mein tareekh = 26 November 1949 (adopted); lagu = 26 January 1950 (jaari).

qe: How many types of 'Liberty' are there in the Preamble?
qh: प्रस्तावना में कितने प्रकार की 'स्वतंत्रता' हैं?
e: Preamble ka 'Liberty of thought, expression, belief, faith and worship' mein kul 5 (paanch) tarah ki swatantrayen shamil hain - sochne ki, bolne (expression) ki, kisi baat par vishwas rakhne (belief) ki, dharmik dridh vishwas (faith) ki, aur pooja-archana (worship) ki. Ye saare jeevan ke laukik aur aadhyatmik (spiritual) kshetron ko cover karte hain aur aage chalkar samvidhan ke Article 19 (1) (a) mein speech aur expression ki swatantrata aur Article 25-28 mein dharmik swatantrata ke roop me vistaar (expand) paate hain. Isliye inki sankhya 3, 4 ya 6 nahi, 5 hai. Exam point: Preamble mein Liberty ke 5 roop - thought, expression, belief, faith, worship.

qe: The phrase 'Justice, Social, Economic and Political' is borrowed from?
qh: 'न्याय, सामाजिक, आर्थिक और राजनीतिक' वाक्यांश कहाँ से लिया गया है?
e: 'Justice, social, economic and political' wala hissa Russian Revolution (1917) se prerit (inspired) hai. Russia ki kraanti ne samajik (jaati/upjaati ke bhed), aarthik (amdani ki asamanata) aur rajnitik (shasan mein bhagidari) nyay - teenon ko ikattha nirnaayak mudda banaya; isi soch ko lekar hamare samvidhan mein DPSP aur Preamble dono drishti ka hissa bane. French Revolution se liberty-equality-fraternity, American Bill of Rights se kanooni hak aur Irish samvidhan se DPSP ka vichar aaya. Exam point: Justice (social-economic-political) = Russian Revolution; baaki Liberty-Equality-Fraternity = French Revolution.

qe: Which case ruled that 'Preamble is NOT a part of the Constitution'?
qh: किस मामले में फैसला सुनाया गया कि 'प्रस्तावना संविधान का हिस्सा नहीं है'?
e: Berubari Union Case (1960) mein Supreme Court ne saaf (clear) kaha tha ki Preamble samvidhan ka hissa (part) nahi hai - uske keval vyakhya mein upyog ho sakta hai, aur uske aadhar par koi adhikar ya shakti nahi nikal sakti. Berubari (ab Paschim Bengal mein) kshetra exchange ki baat chal rahi thi aur Court ne kaha ki Preamble kisi bhi maryada (limit) ko bandhne wali kanooni dastaavez nahi hai. Lekin Kesavananda Bharati (1973) ke faisle ke baad SC ne yah maana ki Preamble samvidhan ka hissa hai. Isi liye donon ka kehna alag-alag (Berubari for 'not part', Kesavananda for 'part') kaha jaata hai. Exam point: Berubari (1960) = Preamble not part; Kesavananda (1973) = Preamble is part.

qe: The word 'Integrity' was added by which Amendment?
qh: 'अखंडता' शब्द किस संशोधन द्वारा जोड़ा गया था?
e: 'Integrity' shabd Preamble mein 42nd samvidhan sanshodhan (1976) dwara joda gaya. Isse pehle Preamble mein sirf 'unity of the Nation' thi, lekin 42nd sanshodhan ne usse badal kar 'unity and integrity of the Nation' kar diya. 'Unity' ka matlab hai ekta (bikharna nahi) aur 'integrity' ka matlab hai akhandata (toona nahi, poora bana rehna) - khaas kar 1971 ke baad ekta-akhandata par zor diya gaya. Isi sanshodhan se 'socialist' aur 'secular' shabd bhi jode gaye the. Exam point: Integrity = 42nd sanshodhan (1976) joda gaya tha; uske saath socialist aur secular bhi.

qe: What is the meaning of 'Democracy' as per Preamble?
qh: प्रस्तावना के अनुसार 'लोकतंत्र' का क्या अर्थ है?
e: 'Democracy' ka arth hai janata ka shasan (People's Rule) - matlab samvidhan ki asli satta (power) janata mein hi nihit (rests) hai. Preamble mein 'democratic' ka matlab sirf 'voting ka adhikar' nahi hai, balki political, social aur economic - teenon tarah ka loktantra hai, jismein aay, darj (status) aur avsar (opportunity) ki samanta ho. Isi liye Preamble mein 'equal protection of law', 'elective head of state' (Republic), aur 'justice' ke teen roop shamil hain. Vote, king ya sen adheen rajya iska ulat hai. Exam point: Democracy = janata ka shasan (People's Rule), aur Bharat mein political + social + economic teenon roop.

qe: Who said 'Preamble is the soul of our Constitution'?
qh: किसने कहा 'प्रस्तावना हमारे संविधान की आत्मा है'?
e: Thakurdas Bhargava (samvidhan sabha ke sadasya) ne Preamble ko 'Soul of the Constitution' kaha tha. Unhone kaha ki samvidhan ke andar ek aisi cheez hai jo samvidhan ka jeevan hi hai - jaise jeev ke shareer mein aatma hoti hai, waise hi Preamble samvidhan ke saare anshon ko jeevan deta hai. Iske alava unhi ne Preamble ko 'Jewel set in the Constitution' bhi kaha. Dr. Ambedkar ka mashhoor wakya Article 32 ke liye tha ('heart and soul'), isliye dono ko mix na karein. Exam point: Soul = Thakurdas Bhargava (Preamble); Heart and Soul = Dr. Ambedkar (Article 32).

qe: Can the 'Basic Structure' of Preamble be destroyed?
qh: क्या प्रस्तावना की 'मूल संरचना' को नष्ट किया जा सकता है?
e: Preamble ke 'Basic Structure' ko koi bhi sanshodhan (amendment) nasht nahi kar sakta. Kesavananda Bharati (1973) ke faisle mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki Parliament Article 368 ki shakti ka istemal karke samvidhan mein koi bhi badlav kar sakti hai, lekin samvidhan ki buniyadi visheshtaon (basic structure) ko nahi badal sakti - aur Preamble ki yeh adarsh (justice, liberty, equality, fraternity, secular, democratic, republic) bhI basic structure ka hissa maane gaye hain. Isliye inko MP (member of parliament) ya rashtrapati, koi bhi nasht nahi kar sakta. Exam point: Basic Structure of Preamble ko destroy nahi kiya ja sakta (Kesavananda + Minerva Mills ke faisle).

qe: Which of these words is placed first in the Preamble?
qh: इनमें से कौन सा शब्द प्रस्तावना में सबसे पहले रखा गया है?
e: Preamble mein shabdon ka kram aisa hai - 'We, the People of India, having solemnly resolved to constitute India into a Sovereign Socialist Secular Democratic Republic...' Isliye pehla shabd 'Sovereign' hi hai, jo sabse pehle rashtra ki azaadi batata hai. Iske baad aate hain Socialist (samajik aarthik nyay), Secular (dharmik samanata), Democratic (janata ka shasan) aur Republic (nirvachit rashtra-adhyaksh). Is kram ko yaad rakhna exam ke liye bahut ahem hai kyunki wikalp (options) mein isi order ko ulat-pulat (confuse) karke poocha jaata hai. Exam point: Preamble ka pehla shabd = Sovereign; aakhri shabd = Republic.

qe: The Preamble is non-justiciable. It means:
qh: प्रस्तावना गैर-न्यायोचित है। इसका मतलब है:
o: It is not enforceable in court (अदालत में लागू नहीं किया जा सकता)
It is not a part of law
e: 'Non-justiciable' ka matlab hai - kanooni roop se court mein lagu (enforce) nahi kiya ja sakta. Preamble ke saare adarsh nirnay (intent) ke roop mein hain, kisi vyakti ke liye kanooni daava (claim) nahi. Isliye court ke saamne koi ye nahi keh sakta ki 'Preamble ke hisaab se mera aarthik nyay hua nahi hai, isliye aapne aadesh de'. Isse ye bhi nahi nikalta ki Preamble ko badla nahi ja sakta (badla ja sakta hai, as per Kesavananda) ya wo kanoon ka hissa nahi hai (Kesavananda ke baad wo hissa maana gaya). Exam point: Non-justiciable = court mein enforce nahi ho sakta (baaki kaanooni dastaavez nahi).

qe: Who drafted the 'Objective Resolution'?
qh: 'उद्देश्य प्रस्ताव' किसने तैयार किया था?
e: 'Objective Resolution' (uddeshya prastav) ko Jawaharlal Nehru ne 13 December 1946 ko samvidhan sabha mein prastut kiya tha aur usse 22 January 1947 ko sweekar kiya gaya. Yahi prastav aage chalkar Preamble ki buniyad (base) bana - usmein Bharat ke swaroop (sovereign republic), nyaay ke teen roop aur samanata ke vishay shamil the. Ismein Sardar Patel, M.N. Roy ya Ambedkar ka koi seedha yogdan prastav ke drafts mein nahi tha (Ambedkar ne Drafting Committee ki adhyakshta ki thi, alag kaam hai). Exam point: Objective Resolution = Jawaharlal Nehru (13 Dec 1946 laaye, 22 Jan 1947 apnaya) = Preamble ka aadhar.

qe: Equality of status and opportunity is mentioned in:
qh: प्रतिष्ठा और अवसर की समानता का उल्लेख कहाँ है?
e: Preamble mein 'Equality of status and opportunity' ka zikr hai - yahi wo pankti hai jahan ek vyakti ke darje (status) aur zindagi ke mauke (opportunity), dono mein barabari ki baat ki gayi hai. Ye sirf Preamble mein nahi, balki samvidhan ke Article 14-18 (Right to Equality) mein kaanooni roop se di gayi hai; Fundamental Duties mein ye batana ki ye insani hak hi hai. Isliye vikalp mein 'All of the above' bhi galat nahi tha, par sahi jawab 'Preamble' hai kyunki prashn (question) isi vishay ko darshata hai. Exam point: Equality of status and opportunity = Preamble ka vaada (aur kaanooni roop Article 14-18).

qe: The Preamble is useful for identifying the:
qh: प्रस्तावना निम्नलिखित में से किसकी पहचान के लिए उपयोगी है?
o: Nature of the Indian State (भारतीय राज्य की प्रकृति)
e: Preamble samvidhan ke swaroop (nature of the Indian State) ko pehchanne ka sabse ahem saadhan hai - usmein saaf likha hai ki Bharat Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic Republic hai, aur uske nagrikon ko nyay, swatantrata, samanta aur bandhutva ka vaada kiya gaya hai. Isi samvidhan ke swapn (Preamble) ko padh kar pata chalta hai ki nirmata kaun sa samaj banana chahte the - samajwadi, dharm-nirpeksh, loktantrik aur kalyan-rajya. Foreign policy, budget ya political parties Preamble se nahi pata chalte (ye alag cheezein hain). Exam point: Preamble se pata chalta hai - bharatiya rajya ka swaroop (nature of the Indian State).

qe: Which of the following is NOT a part of the Preamble?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन प्रस्तावना का हिस्सा नहीं है?
e: Preamble mein 'Adult Suffrage' (vayask matadhikar) nahi hai. Preamble mein shamil hain - Justice (samajik, aarthik, rajnitik), Liberty, Equality, Fraternity, aur shabd Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, Republic. Adult Suffrage (18 saal se upar sabhi nagrikon ko vote ka adhikar) ka zikr samvidhan ke Article 326 mein hai - yani wo Preamble ka hissa nahi hai. Isi tarah 'sarvajanik matadata' ki vyavastha Preamble ke 'Democratic' aur 'Republic' ke vaade ka ek dum (logical) nateeja hai. Exam point: Adult Suffrage = Article 326 (Preamble mein nahi); Preamble mein sirf adarsh aur rashtra-swapn hain.

qe: Which of the following describes India as a 'Secular State'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन भारत को 'धर्मनिरपेक्ष राज्य' के रूप में वर्णित करता है?
e: Bharat ko 'Secular State' sabse pehle Preamble mein kaha gaya hai (42nd sanshodhan 1976 se), kyunki Preamble hi rashtra ka swaroop tay karta hai. Isi ke saath Article 25-28 dharmik swatantra dete hain, Article 44 (DPSP) saman civil code ka lakshya rakhta hai aur Fundamental Rights mein kuchh provisions hain, lekin 'Bharat ek dharma-nirpeksh rajya hai' ye ghosha Preamble hi karta hai. Isi liye Preamble ke 'Secular' shabd ka matlab hai rajya ka koi apna dharm nahi, aur sabhi dharmon ko barabar samman. Exam point: Secular State ka ghosha = Preamble (42nd sanshodhan se); uske kaanooni roop Article 25-28 mein.

qe: The date of 26th November 1949 is significant because:
qh: 26 नवंबर 1949 की तिथि महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि:
e: 26 November 1949 ka din isliye ahem hai kyunki isi din samvidhan sabha ne Bharat ke samvidhan ko apnayaa (adopted) aur antim roop mein tay (finalised) kiya - isi liye isi din Preamble ki tareekh bhi hai, aur 26 January 1950 ko samvidhan lagu hua. Us din pehli aam sansad (first general elections) nahi hui (wo 1951-52 mein hui), Republic Day 1950 se hi manaya jaata hai (26 Jan 1950 se), aur swatantrata 15 August 1947 ko mili thi. Exam point: 26 Nov 1949 = samvidhan adopted (aur Preamble ki tareekh); 26 Jan 1950 = samvidhan lagu/Republic Day.

qe: Which of the following objectives is NOT embodied in the Preamble?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा उद्देश्य प्रस्तावना में शामिल नहीं है?
e: Preamble mein 'Economic liberty' ka zikr nahi hai. Preamble mein Liberty ke 5 roop ginaaye gaye hain - thought (soch), expression (abhivyakti), belief (vishwas), faith (dharmik dhridh vishwas), worship (pooja-archana). Isi tarah fraternity, justice ke teen roop aur equality of status-opportunity hain, lekin 'economic liberty' (aarthik swatantrata) - jaise private property ka adhikar ya vyapar ki azaadi - Preamble mein nahi, balki samvidhan ke Article 19 aur 300A (property rights) mein milta hai. Exam point: Preamble mein Liberty ke 5 roop hain; 'economic liberty' unmein nahi hai (economy ke liye justice wala hissa hai).

qe: What is the true meaning of 'Democratic' in the Preamble?
qh: प्रस्तावना में 'लोकतांत्रिक' का सही अर्थ क्या है?
o: Political, Social and Economic democracy (राजनीतिक, सामाजिक और आर्थिक लोकतंत्र)
e: Preamble ka 'Democratic' shabd keval rajnitik loktantra nahi, balki 'Political, Social aur Economic' - teenon prakar ke loktantra ka lakshya rakhta hai. Rajnitik loktantra ka matlab hai vote, chunav aur shasan mein bhagidari; samajik loktantra ka matlab hai jaati-bhed, chhuachhoot, ling-bhed mitana; aur aarthik loktantra ka matlab hai amir-garib ki khai kam karna aur sabko rozgaar/avsar dena. Isi liye Preamble mein 'Justice - social, economic and political' teenon diye gaye hain aur DPSP mein inke upay bataye gaye hain. Exam point: Democratic = political + social + economic democracy (sirf vote ka adhikar nahi).

qe: The Preamble was amended for the first time during the Prime Ministership of:
qh: प्रस्तावना में पहली बार किसके प्रधानमंत्री काल में संशोधन किया गया था?
e: Preamble ka sanshodhan (amendment) pehli aur aaj tak aakhri baar 1976 mein hua, jab Indira Gandhi Pradhan Mantri thi (42nd samvidhan sanshodhan adhiniyam). Us samay emergency chal rahi thi aur us sanshodhan ne samvidhan mein bahut se badlav kiye - Preamble mein Socialist, Secular aur Integrity shabd jode. Morarji Desai, Lal Bahadur Shastri ya Jawaharlal Nehru ke samay mein Preamble mein koi sanshodhan nahi hua (Nehru ji ke samay 1st sanshodhan 1951 mein hua tha, par wo Preamble ka nahi). Exam point: Preamble ka sanshodhan = 42nd (1976), Indira Gandhi ka samay.

qe: In which case did Justice Hidayatullah equate Preamble with the 'Soul of the Constitution'?
qh: किस मामले में न्यायमूर्ति हिदायतुल्ला ने प्रस्तावना को 'संविधान की आत्मा' के समान माना?
e: Golaknath Case (1967) mein Supreme Court ke nyayadhish (Justice M. Hidayatullah) ne Preamble ko 'Soul of the Constitution' kaha tha. Is faisle mein Court ne kaha tha ki Parliament Fundamental Rights ko chhine nahi sakti (jo baad mein Kesavananda 1973 mein badal gaya). Justice Hidayatullah ka ye wakya Preamble ki importance dikhata hai; sath hi Kesavananda (1973) ne Preamble ko samvidhan ka hissa maana, aur Berubari (1960) ne nahi maana tha. Exam point: Golaknath (1967) mein Justice Hidayatullah ne Preamble ko 'Soul' kaha; Kesavananda (1973) ne ise samvidhan ka hissa maana.

qe: The provision of 'Socialist' in the Preamble aims at:
qh: प्रस्तावना में 'समाजवादी' के प्रावधान का लक्ष्य क्या है?
o: Reducing inequality in income and status (आय और स्थिति में असमानता कम करना)
e: Preamble ka 'Socialist' (samaajvAdi) hissa batata hai ki aay (income), sampatti (wealth) aur darje (status) ki asamanata (inequality) ko kam karna rashtra ka lakshya hai - iske liye samvidhan mein Article 39 (samajik adhidhan ka saman vitaran), Article 41 (kaam, shiksha, madad), Article 43 (khet mazdooron ki sthiti) jaisi DPSP hain. Iska matlab ye nahi ki sabhi kar khaane sarkar ke haath mein kar diye jayen ya private sampatti khatam kar di jaaye - bharat ka model Democratic Socialism hai. Exam point: Socialist = aay-darje ki asamanata kam karna (samajik adhidhan ka saman vitaran; private property ka ant nahi).

qe: Which of these words was NOT present in the Preamble in 1950?
qh: 1950 में इनमें से कौन सा शब्द प्रस्तावना में मौजूद नहीं था?
e: 1950 mein jab samvidhan lagu hua, us samay Preamble mein teen shabd nahi the - Socialist, Secular aur Integrity. Ye teeno shabd 42nd samvidhan sanshodhan (1976) dwara jode gaye. 1950 mein Preamble aisa tha: 'Sovereign Democratic Republic'. Isi tarah us samay 'unity of the Nation' likha tha jise 'unity and integrity of the Nation' banaya gaya. Isliye 'Integrity' wala vikalp sahi hai. Exam point: 1950 mein Preamble mein nahi the - Socialist, Secular, Integrity; inhe 42nd sanshodhan (1976) ne joda.

qe: The 'Preamble' is useful in constitutional interpretation because it:
qh: प्रस्तावना संवैधानिक व्याख्या में उपयोगी है क्योंकि यह:
o: Contains the real objective of the makers (निर्माताओं के वास्तविक उद्देश्य)
e: Preamble samvidhan ki vyakhya (interpretation) mein isliye madadgar hai kyunki usmein samvidhan ke nirmataon ka asli uddeshya (real objective) likha hai - wo kaisa bharat banana chahte the. Jab kisi Article ke arth mein ashmta (controversy) ho, to Supreme Court Preamble ke in adarshon ko dekh kar nirnay karti hai ki kaun sa arth nirmataon ki bhavana ke anukool hai. Lekin Preamble khud enforceable nahi hai (uske aadhar par case nahi chalta) aur shakti ka srot bhi nahi hai. Exam point: Preamble ka upyog = samvidhan ki vyakhya mein; kyunki usmein nirmataon ke asli uddeshya (bhavana) hain.

qe: What is the 'Nature' of the Indian State as per the Preamble?
qh: प्रस्तावना के अनुसार भारतीय राज्य की 'प्रकृति' क्या है?
e: Preamble ke hisaab se bharatiya rajya ka swaroop hai - Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, Republic. Yani bharat ek aisa rajya hai jo bahari hastakshep se mukt hai (sovereign), samajik-aarthik nyay ka lakshya rakhta hai (socialist), sabhi dharmon ko barabar maanta hai (secular), janata ke pratinidhiyon se chalta hai (democratic) aur jiska rashtra-adhyaksh nirvachit hota hai (republic). 'Capitalist' ya 'communist' rajya wala vikalp galat hai; bharat 'mixed economy' aur 'democratic socialism' wala kalyan-rajya hai. Exam point: bharatiya rajya ka swaroop = Sovereign Socialist Secular Democratic Republic (Preamble ka pehla ansh).

qe: The Preamble was debated in the Constituent Assembly after the rest of the Constitution was enacted. True or False?
qh: संविधान के बाकी हिस्सों के लागू होने के बाद संविधान सभा में प्रस्तावना पर चर्चा हुई थी। सही या गलत?
e: Ye kathan sahi hai - samvidhan sabha mein Preamble par bahas sabse ant mein hui thi. Iska karan ye tha ki vidhan-nirmata chahte the ki pehle samvidhan ka poora dhancha, saare ansh aur adhikar tay ho jayen, aur uske baad hi Preamble ko likha jaaye taaki wo samvidhan ke anuroop (fully matching) ho. Isi liye 'Objective Resolution' (22 Jan 1947 ko apnaya gaya) ka antim roop 26 November 1949 ko banaya gaya - jab samvidhan apnayaa gaya. Exam point: Preamble par bahas aur antim roop samvidhan ke baad hua (isliye ye samvidhan ka saar hai).

qe: The 'Ideal of Justice' in the Preamble has been inspired by the:
qh: प्रस्तावना में 'न्याय का आदर्श' किससे प्रेरित है?
e: Preamble ka 'Justice' (samajik, aarthik aur rajnitik) ka vichar Russian Revolution (1917) se aaya tha, kyunki wahan aam janata ko samajik, aarthik aur rajnitik nyay nahi mil raha tha. Isi liye ise 'justice ka Russian model' bhi kehte hain. Iske vipreet 'Liberty, Equality and Fraternity' France ki kraanti se aaye aur 'Republic' ka vichar bhi France se; Irish samvidhan se DPSP aur 'Directive Principles' ka idea aaya. Isliye prashn mein 'Russian Revolution' hi sahi hai. Exam point: Preamble ka Justice = Russian Revolution; Liberty-Equality-Fraternity = French Revolution; DPSP = Irish Constitution.

qe: Which part of the Preamble is called the 'Spirit of the Constitution'?
qh: प्रस्तावना के किस भाग को 'संविधान की भावना' कहा जाता है?
e: Preamble ka poora hissa (the whole Preamble) 'Spirit of the Constitution' maana jaata hai kyunki usmein samvidhan ka mool bhaav (core spirit) hai - adhikar, samanta, nyay aur bandhutva. Isi liye Article 38 (DPSP) ko 'Preamble ki aatma' kaha jaata hai aur Preamble ke adarshon ko 'spirit' kaha jaata hai. Kisi ek shabd (jaise secular ya socialist) ya tareekh ko Preamble ka spirit kehna galat hoga, kyunki samvidhan ka asliy swarup poore Preamble se hi jhalakta hai. Exam point: Spirit of the Constitution = poora Preamble (na ki koi ek shabd ya date).

qe: Can the 'Basic Structure' of the Preamble be amended under Article 368?
qh: क्या अनुच्छेद 368 के तहत प्रस्तावना की 'मूल संरचना' में संशोधन किया जा सकता है?
e: Preamble ke 'Basic Structure' (buniyadi dhancha) ka sanshodhan Article 368 ke teht nahi ho sakta. Kesavananda Bharati (1973) ke faisle mein Supreme Court ne saaf kaha tha ki Parliament samvidhan mein sanshodhan kar sakti hai, lekin samvidhan ki buniyadi visheshtaon (basic structure) ko khatam nahi kar sakti. Preamble ke adarsh - Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, Republic, Justice, Liberty, Equality, Fraternity - inhe basic structure ka hissa maana gaya hai, isliye in par kudhal (attack) karne wala koi bhi sanshodhan adheen (void) ho jaayega. Exam point: Preamble ka basic structure Article 368 ke teht sanshodhit nahi ho sakta (Kesavananda/Bommai ke faisle).

qe: The term 'Secular' means that the Indian State:
qh: 'धर्मनिरपेक्ष' शब्द का अर्थ है कि भारतीय राज्य:
o: Treats all religions as equal (सभी धर्मों को समान मानता है)
e: Preamble ka 'Secular' (dharma-nirpeksh) ka matlab hai ki bharatiya rajya sabhi dharmon ko saman (equal) maanta hai - na wo kisi ek dharm ko badhava (promote) deta hai, na kisi dharm ka virodhi hai, na dharm ko manA (prohibit) karta hai. Rajya ka apna koi dharm nahi hota, lekin wo dharmik samudayon ki sudhaar ke liye kanoon bana sakta hai (jaise Article 17, 25, 44). Isliye 'sabhi dharmon ko saman maanna' hi sahi arth hai; secularism ka matlab dharm nahi rakhna ya nafrat karna nahi hai. Exam point: Secular = rajya ka apna koi dharm nahi + sabhi dharmon ko barabar samman (positive secularism).

qe: How many times 'Integrity' appears in the Preamble?
qh: प्रस्तावना में 'अखंडता' शब्द कितनी बार आता है?
e: 'Integrity' shabd Preamble mein keval ek baar (once) aata hai - 'Fraternity assuring the dignity of the individual and the unity and integrity of the Nation' wali pankti mein. Iska matlab hai rashtra ka poora-poora akhand rehna (bina toote). 'Unity' aur 'Integrity' dono alag shabd hain, lekin Preamble mein ek saath prayukt (used) hote hain kyunki dono ka lakshya ek hai - rashtra ko jod kar rakhna. 'Unity' se bhed-bhav mit kar ekta aati hai, 'integrity' se kshetra bikharta nahi. Exam point: Integrity Preamble mein 1 baar (42nd sanshodhan 1976 se joda gaya).

qe: The Preamble is a source of prohibition upon the powers of legislature.
qh: प्रस्तावना विधायिका की शक्तियों पर निषेध का एक स्रोत है।
e: Ye kathan galat (false) hai - Preamble vidhaayika (legislature) ki shaktiyon par rok (prohibition) ka srot nahi hai. Preamble 'non-justiciable' hai aur sirf samvidhan ki vyakhya mein sahayak hai; kisi vidhaayak (legislative) shakti par rok lagane ka adhikar sirf samvidhan ke Article (jaise Article 13, 32, 245) se milta hai. Preamble ke adarshon ke aadhar par Parliament ya Vidhan Sabha ke kisi kanoon ko radd (strike down) nahi kiya ja sakta - Basic Structure wali baat sirf sanshodhan (Article 368) par lagu hoti hai. Exam point: Preamble vidhaayak shakti par rok ka srot nahi (False); wo keval vyakhya mein sahayak hai.

qe: Which of the following is the 'Key' to the minds of the makers of the Constitution?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन संविधान निर्माताओं के दिमाग की 'कुंजी' है?
e: Preamble ko 'Key to the minds of the makers of the Constitution' (samvidhan nirmataon ke man ki chabhi) kaha jaata hai kyunki usmein hi unke sapne, soch aur nishtha (maksud) ki jhalak milti hai - samajik, aarthik aur rajnitik nyay ke saath samanata aur bandhutva ka samaj. Isi ke through pata chalta hai ki kya unka mool uddeshya sirf rajya chalana tha ya ek naye samaj ka nirmaan. DPSP, Fundamental Rights aur Duties alag-alag hisse hain, par 'man ki chabhi' Preamble hi hai. Exam point: Key to the minds of makers = Preamble (kyunki usmein unke asli uddeshya aur bhavana hai).

qe: Who was the calligrapher of the original Indian Constitution?
qh: मूल भारतीय संविधान के सुलेखक (Calligrapher) कौन थे?
o: Prem Behari Narain Raizada (प्रेम बिहारी नारायण रायजादा)
e: Samvidhan ki asli (original) copy ke prakalpi (calligrapher) Prem Behari Narain Raizada the, jinhone poore samvidhan ko apne haath se sundar daastkhat (handwriting) mein likha tha. Original Preamble ki sajawat (decoration) ke artist Beohar Rammanohar Sinha the, aur poore samvidhan ki deewar-kala Nand Lal Bose ki tha. B.R. Ambedkar ne samvidhan ke dhaanche (draft) par kaam kiya aur B.N. Rau (Constitutional Advisor) ne usse taiyaar karne mein madad ki. Exam point: prakalpi (calligrapher) = Prem Behari Narain Raizada; Preamble page ke artist = Beohar Rammanohar Sinha; decoration = Nand Lal Bose.

qe: The 'Preamble' is borrowed from the constitution of which country?
qh: 'प्रस्तावना' किस देश के संविधान से ली गई है?
e: Preamble ka dhancha-bhasha (phrases, style) America ke samvidhan se liya gaya - khaas kar 'We, the People of India' wali pankti aur Preamble ka tarika. Haan, ye sach hai ki samvidhan ke ansh aur vichar alag-alag deshon se liye gaye - jaise Ireland se DPSP, Britain se sansadiya pranali, Canada se sangh (federation) ka dhancha, Australia se samvidhan ki bhasha-shaili. Isi liye prashn mein 'USA' sahi hai, kyunki Preamble ki bhasha-lipi America se aayi. Exam point: Preamble ka USA se lena = 'We, the People...' (bhasha-shaili); Irish se = DPSP.

qe: The phrase 'Fraternity' in the Preamble does not include:
qh: प्रस्तावना में 'बंधुत्व' शब्द में क्या शामिल नहीं है?
e: Preamble ka 'Fraternity' (bandhutva) mein 'caste supremacy' (jaati ki sarvochta) shaamil nahi hai - ulta, fraternity jaati-bhed aur chhuachhoot ko mitane ka vaada karti hai. Fraternity do cheezein ensure karti hai - vyakti ki garima (dignity) aur rashtra ki ekta-evam-akhandata. Isi liye Preamble ka fraternity Article 15 (bhedbhav par rok), Article 17 (chhuachhoot ka ant) aur Article 51A (bhai-chaara badhana) se juda hai. 'Caste supremacy' to samvidhan ke aadarsh ke bilkul viruddh hai. Exam point: Fraternity = vyakti ki garima + ekta-akhandata (jaati ki sarvochta nahi).

qe: What is the legal nature of the Preamble?
qh: प्रस्तावना की कानूनी प्रकृति क्या है?
o: It can be enforced in Special Cases
It is not enforceable (लागू करने योग्य नहीं है)
e: Preamble ki kanooni sthiti (legal nature) yahi hai ki wo kanooni roop se lagu (enforceable) nahi hai - koi bhi vyakti court mein ja kar ye nahi keh sakta ki 'Preamble ke anusaar mujhe ye adhikar milna chahiye', aur court Preamble ke aadhar par kisi sarkar ko aadesh nahi de sakti. Haan, court samvidhan ke Articles ki vyakhya karte samay Preamble ka upyog kar sakti hai (jaise Kesavananda ke faisle mein Preamble ke aadarshon ka istemal hua). Isliye 'special cases mein enforceable' bhi galat hai. Exam point: Preamble = not enforceable (non-justiciable), sirf vyakhya mein sahayak.

qe: The word 'Sovereign' implies that India can acquire foreign territory.
qh: 'संप्रभु' शब्द का अर्थ है कि भारत विदेशी क्षेत्र का अधिग्रहण कर सकता है।
e: Ye kathan sahi hai - Preamble ke 'Sovereign' hone ka matlab ye bhi hai ki Bharat chaahe to apne mein kisi bahari kshetra ko mila (acquire) sakta hai, jaise Sikkim 1975 mein Bharat ka hissa bana (36th sanshodhan se). Lekin iske liye sanshodhan ki zaroorat ho sakti hai - jaisa Berubari case (1960) mein Court ne kaha tha ki kshetra ke adaan-pradaan (cession ya acquisition) ke liye samvidhan sanshodhan chahiye. Ye shakti kisi yudh ya UN ki anumati par nirbhar nahi hai. Exam point: Sovereign India = kshetra acquire karne ka adhikar (Sikkim 1975), aur dena bhi (Berubari mein sanshodhan ke saath).

qe: Who called the Preamble the 'Soul of the Constitution' (not Heart & Soul)?
qh: किसने प्रस्तावना को 'संविधान की आत्मा' कहा (Heart & Soul नहीं)?
e: 'Soul of the Constitution' (not heart and soul) ka bayan Thakurdas Bhargava ne diya tha. Ye alag hai Dr. B.R. Ambedkar ke mashhoor bayan se, jinhone Article 32 (samvidhanik upchar) ko 'Heart and Soul of the Constitution' kaha tha. Isliye dono bayano ko pariksha mein confuse nahi karna chahiye - agar question 'soul' ke bare mein poochhe to jawab Thakurdas Bhargava (Preamble), aur agar 'heart and soul' poochhe to Dr. Ambedkar (Article 32). K.M. Munshi ne 'Political Horoscope', Nehru ne kuchh nahi (unhone Objective Resolution diya), Palkhivala ne 'Identity Card' kaha. Exam point: Soul = Bhargava (Preamble); Heart and Soul = Ambedkar (Article 32).

qe: Is the word 'Secular' defined anywhere in the Constitution?
qh: क्या संविधान में कहीं भी 'धर्मनिरपेक्ष' शब्द को परिभाषित किया गया है?
e: 'Secular' shabd samvidhan mein kisi ek Article mein paribhashit (defined) nahi hai - ye keval Preamble mein shamil hai (42nd sanshodhan 1976 se). Article 25 dharmik swatantra deta hai, Article 44 saman civil code ka lakshya rakhta hai, lekin inmein kahin bhi 'secular' ka saaf arth nahi likha. Isliye 'secular' ka matlab court ke faislo (jaise Bommai 1994 - secularism basic feature) aur uske Preamble ke upyog se samjha jaata hai. Isi karan bharatiya secularism ko 'positive secularism' kaha jaata hai - rajya sabhi dharmon ko saman maanta hai. Exam point: 'Secular' shabd samvidhan mein kahin paribhashit nahi; ye Preamble mein hai aur iska arth court ne bataya (Bommai, 1994).

qe: The Preamble is the summary of the Constitution.
qh: प्रस्तावना संविधान का सारांश है।
e: Ye kathan sahi hai - Preamble samvidhan ka saar (summary) hai. Usmein poore samvidhan ki buniyadi baatein milti hain: rashtra ka swaroop (sovereign socialist secular democratic republic), uske adarsh (justice, liberty, equality, fraternity) aur 'We, the People' se asli satta janata ke haath mein hone ki ghosha. Welkin 'Only Fundamental Rights' ya 'Only DPSP' ka summary kehna galat hai kyunki Preamble in dono ke saath-saath rashtra ke dhanche (structure) aur nagrik ki bhumika ko bhi sameta hua hai. Exam point: Preamble = poore samvidhan ka saar (summary), sirf ek hisse ka nahi.

qe: In the Preamble, 'Integrity' was added to which concept?
qh: प्रस्तावना में, 'अखंडता' को किस अवधारणा में जोड़ा गया था?
o: Unity of the Nation (राष्ट्र की एकता)
e: Preamble mein 'Integrity' shabd 'unity' ke saath joda gaya hai - poora vaaka hai 'the unity and integrity of the Nation' (rashtra ki ekta aur akhandata). Ye 42nd samvidhan sanshodhan (1976) dwara joda gaya; pehle sirf 'unity of the Nation' likha tha. Iska matlab hai raajya ko na bithana (unity) aur na todna (integrity) - matlab poora kshetra bana rehna. Isi liye 'Liberty', 'Justice' ya 'Equality' wale vikalp galat hain kyunki integrity ka seedha sambandh rashtra ki ekta se hai. Exam point: Integrity = unity ke saath (rashtra ki ekta aur akhandata), 42nd sanshodhan 1976 se joda gaya.

qe: Which among these is a 'Political' justice?
qh: इनमें से कौन सा 'राजनीतिक' न्याय है?
e: 'Political justice' ka matlab hai ki sabhi nagrikon ko rajnitik prakriya mein barabar bhagidari ka adhikar mile - matlab vote daalne, chunav ladne, party banane aur sarkar ke faislon par asar daalne ka mauka. Isi liye 'Right to vote' (matadan ka adhikar) political justice ka udaharan hai, jo Article 326 ke through milta hai. Free education aur right to food samajik-aarthik nyay (social justice) ke udaharan hain, aur equal pay (saman kaam ka saman vetan) aarthik nyay hai. Exam point: Political justice = vote, chunav aur rajnitik bhagidari (Article 326); social = shiksha/poshan; economic = equal pay/sampatti.

qe: The concept of 'Welfare State' is found in:
qh: 'कल्याणकारी राज्य' की अवधारणा कहाँ पाई जाती है?
e: 'Welfare State' (kalyan rajya) ka vichar Preamble aur DPSP dono mein milta hai. Preamble mein 'Justice - social, economic and political', 'Equality of status and opportunity' aur 'Fraternity' ke roop mein kalyan ka aadarsh hai, aur DPSP (Article 36-51) mein sarkar ko nirdesh hai ki wo aisi niti banaye jisse nagrikon ko kaam, shiksha, swasthya, samajik suraksha aur samman-poorvak jeevan mile. Fundamental Rights (sirf rajya par bandhan) aur 7th Schedule (shaktiyon ka vitaran) alag vishay hain. Exam point: Welfare State = Preamble ke aadarsh + DPSP ke nirdesh (dono mein).

qe: The Preamble was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on:
qh: संविधान सभा द्वारा प्रस्तावना को कब अपनाया गया था?
e: Samvidhan sabha ne Preamble ko 22 January 1947 ko sweepkar (adopt) kiya tha, jab Nehru ji ka 'Objective Resolution' saprayog (passed) hua tha; isi liye ye tareekh Preamble mein chhapti hai. Kuchh log 26 November 1949 ko Preamble ki tareekh samajh lEte hain kyunki us din samvidhan ko manzoori mili thi, par Preamble mein likhi hui date 22 January 1947 hai. 15 August 1947 swatantrata ka din hai aur 26 January 1950 samvidhan lagu hone ka. Exam point: Preamble ki tareekh = 22 January 1947 (Objective Resolution wala din).

qe: Which word in the Preamble highlights the 'Brotherhood' among people?
qh: प्रस्तावना का कौन सा शब्द लोगों के बीच 'भाईचारे' को उजागर करता है?
e: Preamble mein 'Fraternity' (bandhutva) shabd hi logon ke aapas ke bhai-chaare (brotherhood) ko darshata hai - 'Fraternity assuring the dignity of the individual and the unity and integrity of the Nation'. Ye shabd French Revolution ke naare se aaya aur iska mool vichar hai sabhi nagrikon ko ek hi manav-parivar ka hissa maanna, jaati-dharm-ling ke bhed ke bina. Isi liye Article 51A (e) mein nagrikon ka farz hai ki wo samrasta aur bhai-chaara badhaaye. Exam point: Brotherhood = Fraternity (bandhutva), jo garima + ekta-akhandata ka vaada karta hai.

qe: The Preamble is called 'Identity Card' by N.A. Palkhivala. True or False?
qh: एन.ए. पालकीवाला ने प्रस्तावना को 'पहचान पत्र' कहा। सही या गलत?
e: Ye kathan sahi hai - N.A. Palkhivala (prasiddh vakil aur samvidhan-vid) ne Preamble ko 'Identity Card of the Constitution' kaha tha, kyunki jaise ek vyakti ka parichay-patra (identity card) use pehchaanta hai, waise hi Preamble se samvidhan ki pehchan hoti hai - kaunsa rajya, kaunsa adarsh, kis janata ka. Isi karan Preamble ke bina samvidhan padhna aise hi hai jaise bina naam ke kisi vyakti ko jaanna. Unhone 'horoscope' ya 'key-note' nahi kaha - wo doosre vidwanon ke bayan the (Munshi - horoscope, Barker - key-note). Exam point: Identity Card = N.A. Palkhivala; Horoscope = K.M. Munshi; Key-note = Ernest Barker.

qe: Which part of the Preamble shows the 'Ideology' of the Constitution?
qh: प्रस्तावना का कौन सा भाग संविधान की 'विचारधारा' दिखाता है?
e: Preamble ke 'keywords' - Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, Republic - samvidhan ki vichaardhaara (ideology) ko darshate hain. Ye shabd batate hain ki samvidhan ka rachneta kaun sa rajya aur samaj banana chahte the: bahari hastakshep se mukt (sovereign), samajik-aarthik nyay wala (socialist), dharm-nirpeksh (secular), janata ke pratinidhiyon wala (democratic) aur nirvachit rashtra-adhyaksh wala (republic). Tareekh aur hastakshar (signatures) sirf rasmi hain, ideology nahi batate. Exam point: Preamble ki ideology = keywords (Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, Republic).

qe: Social justice in the Preamble means:
qh: प्रस्तावना में सामाजिक न्याय का अर्थ है:
o: Equal treatment of all without discrimination (बिना भेदभाव के सभी के साथ समान व्यवहार)
e: Preamble ka 'Social Justice' ka matlab hai sabhi nagrikon ko bina kisi bhedbhav (na jaati, na dharm, na ling, na janm-sthan) ke saman vyavhaar aur saman avsar milna. Isi soch se samvidhan mein Article 15 (bhedbhav par rok), Article 16 (naukri mein saman avsar), Article 17 (chhuachhoot ka ant), Article 46 (DPSP - kamzor vargon ki shiksha aur hith) aur aarakshan (reservation) ki vyavastha aayi. Right to property aur right to strike iske udaharan nahi hain (property ab kanooni adhikar nahi, Article 300A ke teht samvidhanik-adhikar hai). Exam point: Social justice = bina bhed-bhav saman vyavhaar + kamzor vargon ka utthan (Article 15-17, 46).

qe: The 'Liberty' promised in Preamble is absolute.
qh: प्रस्तावना में वादा की गई 'स्वतंत्रता' पूर्ण (Absolute) है।
e: Ye kathan galat (false) hai - Preamble mein di gayi 'Liberty' absolute (nirapeksh, bina rok) nahi hai. Article 19 mein di gayi saari swatantrayen (bolne, milne, ghoomne, pesha, vyapar ki azaadi) uchit seema (reasonable restrictions) ke adheen hain - jaise raajya ki suraksha, sarvajanik vyavastha, sadachaar aur samajik hit ke liye rok lagayi ja sakti hai. Isi tarah 'Liberty' ka sahi upyog doosre ke adhikar ko nuksan pahunchaye bina hi hota hai. Isliye liberty ko 'only in peace time' ya 'only for politicians' kehna bhi galat hai. Exam point: Preamble ki Liberty absolute nahi - uchit seema (reasonable restrictions) ke saath aati hai (Article 19).

qe: Which of these words is placed LAST in the Preamble?
qh: इनमें से कौन सा शब्द प्रस्तावना में सबसे अंत में रखा गया है?
e: Preamble mein aakhri (last) word 'Republic' hai - poora kram hai 'Sovereign Socialist Secular Democratic Republic'. 'Republic' ka matlab hai rashtra ka pramukh (head of state) nirvachit (elected) hoga, janm se nahi milega. Isi liye Bharat ka Rashtrapati chuna jaata hai, aur raajvansh (hereditary monarchy) ka ant ho gaya. 'Sovereign' pehla shabd hai, isliye 'last word' wale prashn mein Republic hi sahi hai; Secular aur Socialist beech mein aate hain. Exam point: Preamble ka pehla shabd = Sovereign, aakhri shabd = Republic (giNaaye gaye keywords mein).

qe: The 'Preamble' can be amended only by Special Majority.
qh: प्रस्तावना को केवल विशेष बहुमत द्वारा संशोधित किया जा सकता है।
e: Ye kathan sahi hai - Preamble ko sanshodhit karne ke liye 'special majority' (visesh bahumat) ki zaroorat hoti hai, kyunki Preamble samvidhan ka hissa hai (Kesavananda 1973 ke baad). Article 368 ke anusaar sanshodhan ke liye sansad ke dono sadan (Lok Sabha + Rajya Sabha) mein kul sadasyon ka bahumat aur upasthit-evam-matdan karne wale sadasyon ka do-tihai (2/3) bahumat chahiye. Isi liye keval 'simple majority' se Preamble nahi badal sakta, aur ye bhi galat hai ki usmein sanshodhan hi nahi ho sakta (1976 mein ek baar hua). Exam point: Preamble sanshodhan = special majority (Article 368), ki saal 1976 mein hua (42nd).

qe: Which language of the Preamble is influenced by the Australian Constitution?
qh: प्रस्तावना की कौन सी भाषा ऑस्ट्रेलियाई संविधान से प्रभावित है?
e: Preamble ki bhasha-shaili (language/style) par Australia ke samvidhan ka prabhav maana jaata hai - khaas kar 'We, the People' jaise prayog, 'do hereby adopt, enact and give to ourselves' wali pankti ka dhancha, aur samvidhan ko likhne ka tarika. 'Integrity' shabd Preamble mein 1976 mein joda gaya (kisi desh se nahi liya gaya seedhe), 'Secular' aur 'Republic' ke vishay alag deshon se jude hain (France - republic; secular ka vichar bharatiya parampara se). Exam point: Preamble ki bhasha/style = Australian Constitution; DPSP = Irish; Federation = Canadian; Sansad = British.

qe: In which Case did SC declare 'Preamble is an integral part of constitution'?
qh: किस मामले में SC ने घोषित किया 'प्रस्तावना संविधान का अभिन्न अंग है'?
o: Both A and C (A और C दोनों)
e: Kesavananda Bharati Case (1973) aur S.R. Bommai Case (1994) dono mein Supreme Court ne maana ki Preamble samvidhan ka integral (abhinna) hissa hai. Kesavananda mein Court ne yah bhi kaha ki Preamble ke adarsh basic structure ka hissa hain, aur Berubari (1960) wale faisle ko badal diya. Bommai case mein secularism ko basic feature maana gaya. LIC Case aur baaki vikalp isse alag mudde hain (LIC case - Article 31B/schedule wala faisla). Exam point: Preamble = samvidhan ka integral part (Kesavananda 1973 + Bommai 1994); Berubari (1960) ne pehle ulta kaha tha.

qe: Which word was used as a slogan in the Russian Revolution?
qh: रूसी क्रांति में किस शब्द का प्रयोग नारे के रूप में किया गया था?
e: Russian Revolution ke samay 'Justice' (nyay) ek mukhya naara (slogan) tha kyunki aam janata - mazdoor aur kisan - ko samajik, aarthik aur rajnitik nyay nahi mil raha tha. Isi naare aur vichar ko hamare samvidhan ne apnaya aur Preamble mein 'Justice - social, economic and political' likha gaya. 'Liberty, Equality, Fraternity' French Revolution ke naare the, 'Equality' aur 'Fraternity' bhi wahi se aaye; isliye prashn ke wikalpon mein 'Justice' hi sahi jawab hai kyunki Justice ka srot Russian Revolution hai. Exam point: Russian Revolution ka naara = Justice; French Revolution ke naare = Liberty, Equality, Fraternity.

qe: The term 'Sovereign' makes India a member of the Commonwealth?
qh: 'संप्रभु' शब्द भारत को राष्ट्रमंडल का सदस्य बनाता है?
e: Ye kathan galat (false) hai - 'Sovereign' hone ka matlab ye nahi ki Bharat Commonwealth ka sadasya nahi reh sakta. Commonwealth (raashtra-mandal) ek swaichchhik (voluntary) sangathan hai jismein jukne ya na jukne se kisi desh ki samprabhuta (sovereignty) par koi asar nahi padta. Bharat 1949 se Commonwealth ka sadasya hai, lekin uspar British tilak (Crown) ka koi adheen nahi hai - wo apni vidhi, videsh-niti aur arth-niti khud banata hai. Vikalpon mein 'only if Queen allows' wala bayan bilkul galat hai kyunki Queen ka koi aadesh nahi chalta. Exam point: Commonwealth ki sadasyata sovereignty ko khatam nahi karti (Sovereign India Commonwealth mein reh sakta hai).

qe: The word 'Socialist' in Indian Constitution is a 'brand' of:
qh: भारतीय संविधान में 'समाजवादी' शब्द किसका एक 'ब्रांड' है?
e: Preamble ka 'Socialist' shabd bharat mein 'Democratic Socialism' ke roop mein samjha jaata hai - matlab samajik aur aarthik nyay (garibi, asamanata ka ant) democratic, shaantipurn aur samvidhanik raaste se hasil karna, na ki kisi kranti, ek-party shasan ya samanya niyantran (state control) se. Isi liye bharat ek 'mixed economy' chalta hai jahan private aur sarkari kshetra dono hain, aur DPSP (Article 39, 41, 43) ke through kalyan rajya ka lakshya paane ki koshish hoti hai. Marxism aur Laissez-faire (bilkul azad bazar) iske vipreet sira hain. Exam point: bharat ka socialism = Democratic Socialism (samajik nyay + democratic tareeka + mixed economy).

qe: Who among the following was the artist of Preamble page decoration?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन प्रस्तावना पृष्ठ की सजावट के कलाकार थे?
e: Preamble page ki sajawat (decoration) ke artist Beohar Rammanohar Sinha the - unhone original samvidhan ke hindi version ke Preamble page par sundar chitrakari (calligraphy art) ki thi. Poore samvidhan ki deewar-kala (border art) Nand Lal Bose ki thi (jo Shantiniketan se the), samvidhan ke prakalpi (calligrapher) Prem Behari Narain Raizada the, aur Amrita Sher-Gil aur M.F. Hussain bharat ke mashhoor chitrakar the par unhone samvidhan par kaam nahi kiya. Exam point: Preamble page ke artist = Beohar Rammanohar Sinha; samvidhan ki deewar-kala = Nand Lal Bose; prakalpi = Prem Behari Narain Raizada.

qe: The Preamble does not contain 'Signatures' of the makers.
qh: प्रस्तावना में निर्माताओं के 'हस्ताक्षर' नहीं हैं।
e: Ye kathan sahi hai - Preamble par samvidhan ke nirmataon ke hastakshar (signatures) nahi hain. Original samvidhan par 24 January 1950 ko sadasyaon ne hastakshar kiye the, lekin Preamble ke page par ve hastakshar nahi lagte - wahan sirf Preamble ka text aur uski sajawat hoti hai. Isi karan kuchh vidwaan Preamble ko 'samvidhan ka ansh (part)' maanne mein ashmta (doubt) rakhte the, jise Kesavananda (1973) ne door kar diya. Exam point: Preamble par nirmataon ke signature nahi hote (ye sahi kathan hai).

qe: Which part of the Preamble shows the 'Enacting' power?
qh: प्रस्तावना का कौन सा भाग 'अधिनियमित' करने की शक्ति दिखाता है?
o: The last paragraph (We do hereby adopt, enact...)
e: Preamble ka aakhri ansh (last paragraph) 'We do hereby adopt, enact and give to ourselves this Constitution' wala hai - yahi samvidhan ko sweekar karne ki 'enacting power' (samvidhan banane ki kshamta) ko darshata hai. Isi pankti se pata chalta hai ki samvidhan kisi bahari shakti ne nahi, balki 'We, the People of India' ne khud apne liye banaya aur sweekar kiya - matlab asli satta janata ke paas hai. Keywords rashtra ka swaroop batate hain, tareekh sirf samay batati hai. Exam point: enacting power (samvidhan saapon ki shakti) = Preamble ka antim paragraph ('adopt, enact and give to ourselves').

qe: The 'Preamble' is a part of 'Basic Structure'.
qh: प्रस्तावना 'मूल संरचना' का एक हिस्सा है।
e: Ye kathan sahi hai - Preamble samvidhan ke 'Basic Structure' (buniyadi dhanche) ka hissa hai. Kesavananda Bharati (1973) ke faisle ke baad Supreme Court ne maana ki Preamble samvidhan ka abhinna hissa hai, aur baad ke faislon (jaise Minerva Mills 1980 aur Bommai 1994) mein Preamble ke adarsh - secularism, democracy, republic, justice, liberty - basic structure maane gaye. Iska nateeja ye hai ki Parliament in adarshon ko khatam karne wala sanshodhan nahi kar sakti. Exam point: Preamble (poora, kisi ek hisse ko nahi) basic structure ka hissa hai.

qe: Which of these is NOT a type of Equality in Preamble?
qh: इनमें से कौन सा प्रस्तावना में समानता का प्रकार नहीं है?
e: Preamble mein 'Income' (aay) ke aadhar par samanata (equality) ka koi zikr nahi hai - Preamble sirf 'Equality of status and opportunity' kehta hai, matlab darje (status) aur avsar (opportunity) mein barabari. Aay ki samanata ka lakshya Preamble mein nahi, balki DPSP (Article 39 - aay aur sampatti ka saman vitaran) mein milta hai. Isi tarah 'Equality before law' (Article 14) aur 'equal pay for equal work' (Article 39(d)) bhi alag hain. Exam point: Preamble mein equality ke 2 aadhar - status aur opportunity (income nahi); aay-samanata ka lakshya DPSP mein.

qe: The word 'Sovereign' is mentioned in the beginning of the Preamble.
qh: 'संप्रभु' शब्द का उल्लेख प्रस्तावना की शुरुआत में किया गया है।
e: Ye kathan sahi hai - Preamble mein 'Sovereign' shabd sabse pehle aata hai (shuruaat mein). Poora aarambh is prakar hai: 'We, the People of India, having solemnly resolved to constitute India into a Sovereign Socialist Secular Democratic Republic...' Isliye Sovereign pehla, phir socialist, secular, democratic aur aakhir mein Republic aata hai. Yahi kram batata hai ki rashtra ki sabse pehli pehchan uski samprabhuta (independence) hai, uske baad hi uske samajik, dharmik aur loktantrik aadarsh aate hain. Exam point: Preamble mein shabdon ka order - Sovereign (first), Republic (last).

qe: How many words are there in the original Preamble?
qh: मूल प्रस्तावना में कितने शब्द हैं?
e: Asli (original) Preamble mein 73 shabd the (English version mein). Ye sankhya 1976 se pehle ki hai - 42nd sanshodhan ke baad teen shabd (Socialist, Secular, Integrity) jodne se shabdon ki sankhya badh gayi. Isi tarah poore samvidhan mein shuru mein 395 Article aur 8 Schedule the, jo aaj badal gaye hain (12 Schedules). Isliye '73' wala aankda original Preamble ki baat karta hai; 81, 85 ya 52 galat hain. Exam point: original Preamble = 73 shabd (1976 se pehle); sanshodhan ke baad shabd badh gaye.

qe: Who called the Preamble the 'Jewel set in the Constitution'?
qh: किसने प्रस्तावना को 'संविधान में जड़ा हुआ रत्न' कहा?
e: Preamble ko 'Jewel set in the Constitution' (samvidhan mein jada hua ratna) kehne ka shrey Thakurdas Bhargava ko jaata hai. Unhone hi Preamble ko 'Soul of the Constitution' bhi kaha tha. Isi tarah K.M. Munshi ne 'Political Horoscope', N.A. Palkhivala ne 'Identity Card' aur Ernest Barker ne 'Key-note' kaha. Ambedkar ne Preamble ke liye koi aisa upmaan (metaphor) nahi diya; unka prasiddh bayan Article 32 ke liye hai. Exam point: 'Jewel set in the Constitution' aur 'Soul' - dono Thakurdas Bhargava ke bayan hain (Preamble ke liye).

qe: The 'Preamble' of the Indian Constitution is based on which document?
qh: भारतीय संविधान की 'प्रस्तावना' किस दस्तावेज पर आधारित है?
e: Bharat ka Preamble apne vichaar aur dhanche ke liye 'Objective Resolution' (uddeshya prastav) par aadharit hai, jise Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru ne 13 December 1946 ko samvidhan sabha mein prastut kiya tha aur 22 January 1947 ko sweekar kiya gaya. Usi prastav mein Bharat ko 'Sovereign Independent Republic' banane, nyay ke teen roop, samanata aur swatantrata ke vishay tay hue the - yahi Preamble ban gaya. Government of India Act 1935 se shasan ka dhancha aaya tha (na ki Preamble ka), August Offer 1940 ki rajnitik peshkash thi, aur Nehru Report 1928 thi. Exam point: Preamble ka aadhar = Objective Resolution (Nehru, 1946-47).

qe: Which three words were added to the Preamble by the 42nd Amendment (1976)?
qh: 42वें संशोधन (1976) द्वारा प्रस्तावना में कौन से तीन शब्द जोड़े गए थे?
e: 42nd samvidhan sanshodhan (1976) ne Preamble mein teen shabd jode - Socialist, Secular aur Integrity. Isse pehle Preamble mein 'unity of the Nation' likha tha jise badal kar 'unity and integrity of the Nation' kiya gaya. Us samay Indira Gandhi Pradhan Mantri thi aur emergency chal rahi thi; isi sanshodhan ne samvidhan ke bahut se ansh (jaise Fundamental Duties - Article 51A) bhi jode. 'Sovereign, Democratic, Republic' to pehle se hi the. Exam point: 42nd sanshodhan se Preamble mein jode gaye 3 shabd - Socialist, Secular, Integrity.

qe: In which famous case did the Supreme Court declare that the 'Preamble is a part of the Constitution'?
qh: किस प्रसिद्ध मामले में सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने घोषणा की कि 'प्रस्तावना संविधान का हिस्सा है'?
e: Kesavananda Bharati Case (1973) wahi faisla hai jismein Supreme Court ne saaf kaha ki Preamble samvidhan ka hissa (part) hai - matlab wo bhi samvidhan ke saath padha jaayega aur uski vyakhya mein upyog hoga. Iske ulta Berubari Union Case (1960) mein Court ne kaha tha ki Preamble samvidhan ka hissa nahi hai. Golaknath (1967) mein Fundamental Rights ke sanshodhan ka mudda tha aur Minerva Mills (1980) mein basic structure ka. Exam point: Preamble ko samvidhan ka hissa maanne wala ahem faisla = Kesavananda Bharati (1973).

qe: What is the correct sequence of words in the Preamble?
qh: प्रस्तावना में शब्दों का सही क्रम क्या है?
e: Preamble mein shabdon ka sahi kram: 'Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, Republic'. Iska matlab hai pehle samprabhuta (independence), phir samajik-aarthik nyay (socialist), phir dharm-nirpekshta (secular), phir janata ka shasan (democratic) aur ant mein nirvachit rashtra-pramukh (republic). Isi kram ko phase-phase yaad rakhna chahiye kyunki prashn mein options mein shabd ulate-pulate karke poochhe jaate hain aur sirf ek hi kram sahi hota hai. Exam point: Preamble ke keywords ka sahi order - Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, Republic.

qe: The idea of 'Liberty, Equality, and Fraternity' in the Preamble is borrowed from?
qh: प्रस्तावना में 'स्वतंत्रता, समानता और बंधुत्व' का विचार कहाँ से लिया गया है?
e: Preamble ka 'Liberty, Equality aur Fraternity' wala teen-adarsh (triad) French Revolution (1789) se liya gaya hai. France ke naare 'Liberte, Egalite, Fraternite' ne samvidhan-nirmataon ko bahut prabhavit kiya; isi tarah 'Republic' ka dhancha bhi France se aaya (Britain ek raajvanshiya pranali wala desh hai, aur Russia se 'Justice' ka vichar aaya). American Revolution se 'We the People' aur Bill of Rights ka vichar aaya. Exam point: Liberty-Equality-Fraternity = French Revolution (France); Justice = Russian Revolution; We the People = USA.

qe: The Preamble mentions how many types of 'Justice'?
qh: प्रस्तावना में कितने प्रकार के 'न्याय' का उल्लेख है?
e: Preamble mein 'Justice' ke teen roop (three types) ginaaye gaye hain - Social justice, Economic justice aur Political justice. Isi liye poora vaaka hai 'Justice, social, economic and political'. In teenon ke lakshya ko paane ke liye DPSP ke Article 38, 39, 41, 46 jaise nirdesh diye gaye hain, aur Fundamental Rights (Article 14-18, 19, 21) in adhikaron ko kanooni roop dete hain. 'Four' ya 'Five' wale vikalp isliye galat hain kyunki Preamble mein sirf teen hi prakar likhe hain. Exam point: Preamble mein Justice ke 3 roop - social, economic, political (is order mein).

qe: Who described the Preamble as the 'Horoscope of our Sovereign Democratic Republic'?
qh: किसने प्रस्तावना को 'हमारे संप्रभु लोकतांत्रिक गणराज्य की जन्मकुंडली' कहा था?
e: Preamble ko 'Horoscope of our Sovereign Democratic Republic' kehne wala bayan K.M. Munshi (Kanhaiyalal Munshi) ka hai, jo samvidhan sabha ke sadasya aur Drafting Committee ke member the. Unhone 'political horoscope' shabd bhi istemal kiya, kyunki jaise kundli aage ka raasta dikhati hai, waise hi Preamble samvidhan ki bhavishya-disha aur adarsh batata hai. Jawaharlal Nehru ne Objective Resolution diya, B.R. Ambedkar ne Article 32 ko heart and soul kaha, aur Thakurdas Bhargava ne Preamble ko soul kaha. Exam point: Horoscope = K.M. Munshi (Preamble ke liye); Soul = Thakurdas Bhargava; Heart and Soul = B.R. Ambedkar (Article 32).

qe: What is the date mentioned in the Preamble for the adoption of the Constitution?
qh: प्रस्तावना में संविधान को अपनाने की कौन सी तिथि उल्लेखित है?
e: Preamble mein samvidhan ki sweepkriti (adoption) ki tareekh 26 November 1949 likhi hai - isi din samvidhan sabha ne samvidhan ko apnayaa aur Preamble ko antim roop diya. Iske doosre ahem din hain: 15 August 1947 (swatantrata), aur 26 January 1950 (samvidhan lagu hua, Republic Day ke roop me manaya jaata hai). Kai prashnon mein 26 Jan 1950 ko samvidhan adopt karne ki date samjha jaata hai - jo galat hai. Exam point: Preamble mein tareekh = 26 November 1949 (adoption); 26 January 1950 = commencement (lagu).

qe: The term 'We, the people of India' in the Preamble implies that:
qh: 'हम, भारत के लोग' शब्द का अर्थ है कि:
e: 'We, the people of India' wali pankti ka matlab hai ki samvidhan ka asli maalik aur sarvochch satta (supreme authority) India ki janata hi hai. Isi liye bharat mein sansad (Parliament), rashtra-adhyaksh (President) ya sarkar 'supreme' nahi hai - ye sab janata dwara chune gaye pratinidhi hain aur janata ke prati jawabdeh hain. Isi soch ke aadhar par vote ka adhikar, chunav aur jan-sunwai (public hearing) jaise upaay bane hain. Exam point: 'We the people' = janata sarvochch praadhikari (people are supreme), isliye loktantra mein satta janata se hi aati hai.

qe: How many times has the Preamble of India been amended so far?
qh: अब तक भारत की प्रस्तावना में कितनी बार संशोधन किया गया है?
e: Bharat ke Preamble mein aaj tak keval ek baar sanshodhan (once) hua hai - 1976 mein 42nd samvidhan sanshodhan dwara, jismein Socialist, Secular aur Integrity jode gaye. Isse pehle koi sanshodhan nahi hua tha, aur uske baad bhi koi sanshodhan nahi hua, isliye 'only once' sahi hai. 'Twice' ya 'Thrice' galat hain kyunki Preamble mein social ya governmental badlav ke bawajood ye teen shabd hi jode gaye the. Exam point: Preamble mein sanshodhan ki sankhya = 1 (42nd, 1976).

qe: Which of the following is described as the 'Key to the Constitution'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किसे 'संविधान की कुंजी' कहा जाता है?
e: Preamble ko 'Key to the Constitution' (samvidhan ki chaabi) kaha jaata hai kyunki ise padh kar samvidhan ke saare ansh (Articles, Rights, DPSP) ke asli uddeshya se samajh aata hai - jaise tala khOlne ke liye chaabi chahiye, waise hi samvidhan ke arth kholne ke liye Preamble ki chaabi chahiye. Isi ke aadhar par court samvidhan ki vyakhya karti hai. Fundamental Rights, Duties aur DPSP samvidhan ke bhag hain, lekin unka mool 'key' Preamble hi hai. Exam point: Key to the Constitution = Preamble (kyunki ye samvidhan ke uddeshya aur adarsh ko kholta hai).

qe: What does the word 'Sovereign' (प्रभुत्व संपन्न) in the Preamble mean?
qh: प्रस्तावना में 'प्रभुत्व संपन्न' शब्द का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Both internal and external independence (आंतरिक और बाहरी स्वतंत्रता)
e: 'Sovereign' (samprabhuta) ka poora arth hai - Bharat ki antarik (internal) aur bahri (external) dono prakar ki swatantrata. Internal independence ka matlab hai ki desh ke andar kisi bhi chhoti-moti satta (jaise kisi kshetra, samuh ya vyakti) ka rajya par koi niyantran nahi, aur External ka matlab hai koi bahari desh ya sangathan apni marzi nahi thop sakta. Commonwealth ki sadasyata sirf ek swaichchhik (voluntary) sandarbh hai, jo is swatantrata ko nahi tod sakta. Exam point: Sovereign = internal + external dono swatantrata (poorn samprabhuta).

qe: Which type of 'Socialism' does the Indian Constitution support?
qh: भारतीय संविधान किस प्रकार के 'समाजवाद' का समर्थन करता है?
e: Bharat ka samvidhan 'Democratic Socialism' ka samarthan karta hai - iska arth hai ki samajik aur aarthik nyay (garibi, asamanata, bekar I ka ant) democratic, samvidhanik aur shaantipurn tareeke se hasil karna, na ki Communist ya Marx puran (violent/ one party) revolutation se. Isi liye bharat mein sarkari aur niji, dono kshetra (public-private) ek saath chalte hain aur samvidhan ke liye DPSP ke through kalyan-rajya ka nirmaan karna lakshya hai. Radical socialism ya communistic socialism ek-party shasan maangte hain, jo bharat ke democratic dhanche ke vipreet hai. Exam point: bharat ka socialism = Democratic Socialism (samajik nyay + democratic vyavastha + mixed economy).

qe: The Supreme Court in which year stated that 'Secularism' is a basic feature of the Constitution?
qh: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने किस वर्ष कहा था कि 'धर्मनिरपेक्षता' संविधान की एक मूल विशेषता है?
e: 1994 mein S.R. Bommai Case ke faisle mein Supreme Court ne saaf kaha ki 'Secularism' samvidhan ki buniyadi visheshata (basic feature) hai - isliye 42nd sanshodhan dwara Preamble mein 'secular' shabd jodna ahem tha aur ise hataya nahi ja sakta. Is faisle mein ye bhi tay hua ki rajya kisi dharm ka paksh nahi lega aur dharm ke aadhar par rajnitik dal (Political Party) banakar vote ki rajniti karna samvidhan ke virudh hai. Isse pehle Kesavananda (1973) ne basic structure ki neev rakhi thi. Exam point: Secularism = basic feature, S.R. Bommai Case (1994).

qe: The term 'Justice' (Social, Economic, Political) in the Preamble is taken from?
qh: प्रस्तावना में 'न्याय' (सामाजिक, आर्थिक, राजनीतिक) का विचार कहाँ से लिया गया है?
e: Preamble ka 'Justice - social, economic and political' wala hissa Russian Revolution (1917) se liya gaya hai. Russia ki kraanti ke samay samajik (barabari ke bina bhed-bhav), aarthik (sampatti ka saman vitaran) aur rajnitik (sabko vote aur bhagidari) nyay - teenon ki maang thi. Isi liye us samay ka mool 'Justice' shabd hi Russian Revolution ka naara bana. Irish samvidhan se hamne DPSP ka dhancha liya, American Bill of Rights se kanooni adhikar aur French Revolution se liberty-equality-fraternity. Exam point: Justice (social-economic-political) = Russian Revolution; DPSP = Irish Republic; Bill of Rights = American.

qe: Which of the following is the correct definition of 'Secular' in the Indian context?
qh: भारतीय संदर्भ में 'धर्मनिरपेक्ष' की सही परिभाषा क्या है?
o: State supports all religions equally (राज्य सभी धर्मों का समान समर्थन करता है)
e: Bharat ke sandarbh mein 'Secular' ko 'positive secularism' kehte hain, jiska matlab hai ki rajya ka koi apna dharm nahi (nor religous affiliation) lekin wo sabhi dharmon ko saman samman aur samrakshan deta hai, aur samajik sudhaar ke liye dharmik maamlon mein hastakshep bhi kar sakta hai. Isi liye samvidhan ke Article 25 dharmik swatantra deta hai, Article 17 (chhuachhoot) aur Article 44 (saman civil code) ke nirdesh hain, aur dharmik sthalon ki sudhaar ki jaati hai. Western secularism mein rajya aur church poori tarah alag hote hain; bharat mein tanaav (diversity) ko dekh kar ye model apnaya gaya. Exam point: Secular = rajya ka apna dharm nahi + sabhi dharmon ko barabar samman (positive secularism).

qe: In the Berubari Union case (1960), what did the Supreme Court say about the Preamble?
qh: बेरुबारी यूनियन मामले (1960) में सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने प्रस्तावना के बारे में क्या कहा?
o: It is NOT a part of Constitution (संविधान का हिस्सा नहीं है)
It is a part of Constitution
It is supreme to the Constitution
e: Berubari Union Case (1960) mein Supreme Court ne saaf kaha tha ki Preamble samvidhan ka hissa nahi hai aur wo keval ek 'guide' ki tarah hai - isliye uske aadhar par koi kanooni adhikar nahi milta. Us samay Berubari kshetra (Paschim Bengal) Pakistan ko dene ka mudda tha aur Court ne kaha ki iske liye samvidhan sanshodhan ki zaroorat hogi. Lekin Kesavananda Bharati (1973) ke baad Court ne maana ki Preamble samvidhan ka hissa hai; isliye aaj ka sthiti alag hai. Isi tarah 'cannot be amended' wala vikalp bhi Berubari se nahi nikalta. Exam point: Berubari (1960) = Preamble NOT a part of the Constitution (baad mein Kesavananda ne badla).

qe: The word 'Fraternity' (बंधुत्व) in the Preamble assures two things. What are they?
qh: प्रस्तावना में 'बंधुत्व' दो चीजों का आश्वासन देता है। वे क्या हैं?
