o: Dignity of individual & Unity/Integrity of nation (व्यक्ति की गरिमा और राष्ट्र की एकता)
e: Preamble ka 'Fraternity' (bandhutva) do cheezein assure karta hai - (1) vyakti ki garima (dignity of the individual) aur (2) rashtra ki ekta avam akhandata (unity and integrity of the Nation). Isi liye Rajya aisi vyavastha karta hai ki kisi vyakti ka samman (dignity) bhanga na ho aur desh ki ekta par aanch na aaye. Justice, Liberty, Equality, Rights aur Duties bhi isse jude hain, lekin 'two things' wale prashn ko dhyan se padhein - 'dignity of individual & unity/integrity of nation' hi hamare Preamble ki asli bhasha hai. Exam point: Fraternity = dignity of individual + unity and integrity of nation (Preamble ke shabd).

qe: Who called the Preamble the 'Key-note' to the Constitution?
qh: किसने प्रस्तावना को संविधान का 'की-नोट' कहा था?
e: 'Key-note' (mool sur) wala bayan Ernest Barker (British rajnitik vaigyanik) ka hai, jinhone Preamble ko samvidhan ka keynote kaha - jaise mausiqi mein keynote poore sur ka aadhar hoti hai. B.R. Ambedkar ka mashhoor bayan Article 32 (heart and soul) ke liye tha, K.M. Munshi ne 'political horoscope' aur N.A. Palkhivala ne 'identity card' kaha. Isliye 'Key-note' ka jawab Ernest Barker hi hoga. Exam point: Key-note = Ernest Barker; Horoscope = K.M. Munshi; Identity Card = Palkhivala; Soul = Thakurdas Bhargava; Heart and Soul = Ambedkar (Article 32).

qe: The 'Socialist' goals of India aim to end:
qh: भारत के 'समाजवादी' लक्ष्यों का उद्देश्य क्या समाप्त करना है?
e: Preamble ka 'Socialist' hissa ye batata hai ki rashtra ka lakshya samajik aur aarthik asamanata ka ant hai; iske liye samvidhan ke DPSP mein Article 39 (aay aur sampatti ka saman vitaran), Article 41 (kaam, shiksha, madad), Article 46 (kamzor vargon ki shiksha aur hith) jaise nirdesh hain. Iska arth ye bilkul nahi hai ki sabhi dharm ka ant karna, private property hatana ya sab kar chhinn lena; bharat ka model = 'mixed economy + democratic socialism'. Isi liye 'inequality of opportunity' kam karna socialist lakshya hai. Exam point: Socialist ka lakshya = avsar aur aay ki asamanata ka ant (DPSP - Article 39, 41, 46).

qe: Can the Preamble be used to override the specific provisions of the Constitution?
qh: क्या प्रस्तावना का उपयोग संविधान के विशिष्ट प्रावधानों को रद्द करने के लिए किया जा सकता है?
e: Preamble ke saath samvidhan ke kisi saaf (specific) upbandh (provision) ka virodh? Aisa nahi ho sakta - Preamble ko kisi Article par prabhavi (override) karne wala saadhan nahi maana jaata. Ye keval samvidhan ki vyakhya mein sahayak hai; agar koi Article ka arth saaf hai to court use Preamble ke aadhar par badal nahi sakti, haan wo Preamble ke adarshon ko dhyan mein rakh kar Article ka vistrit arth tay kar sakti hai. Isliye Preamble ko emergency ya President ki anumati wali shakti nahi hai. Exam point: Preamble samvidhan ke articles ko override nahi karta (keval vyakhya mein sahayak - aid to interpretation).

qe: What was the status of India on 26th January 1950?
qh: 26 जनवरी 1950 को भारत की स्थिति क्या थी?
e: 26 January 1950 ko Bharat ka swaroop tha - 'Sovereign Democratic Republic' (samvidhan lagu hone ke samay). 'Socialist', 'Secular' aur 'Integrity' shabd 42nd sanshodhan (1976) se jode gaye, isliye 1950 mein Preamble poora 'Sovereign Socialist Secular Democratic Republic' nahi tha. 'Colony' bilkul galat hai aur 'Dominion' 15 August 1947 se le kar 26 January 1950 tak ki sthiti thi. Isliye 1950 ki sahi sthiti 'Sovereign Democratic Republic' thi. Exam point: 1950 mein bharat = Sovereign Democratic Republic; 'Socialist-Secular-Integrity' 1976 se aaye.

qe: Who is known as the 'Identity Card of the Constitution' according to N.A. Palkhivala?
qh: एन.ए. पालकीवाला के अनुसार किसे 'संविधान का पहचान पत्र' कहा जाता है?
e: 'Identity Card of the Constitution' wala bayan N.A. Palkhivala ka hai aur wo Preamble ko darshata hai - unhone kaha ki Preamble samvidhan ka parichay-patra (identity card) hai, jisse samvidhan ki pehchan hoti hai. Fundamental Rights, Parliament ya DPSP sab samvidhan ke ahem hisse hain, lekin 'identity' ke roop mein Preamble hi pehchana jaata hai, kyunki wahi rashtra ka swaroop, uske adarsh aur janata ki sarvochchta - teenon ko ek saath batata hai. Exam point: Identity Card of the Constitution = Preamble (N.A. Palkhivala ka bayan).

qe: Equality of 'Status and Opportunity' is mentioned in:
qh: 'प्रतिष्ठा और अवसर' की समानता का उल्लेख कहाँ है?
e: Preamble mein 'Equality of status and opportunity' ka zikr hai. Iska arth hai ki samaj mein kisi vyakti ka darja (status) uske janm, jaati, dharm, ling ya dhan ke aadhar par tay nahi hoga, aur zindagi mein aage badhne ke avsar (opportunity) sabhi ko barabar milenge. Isi vaade ka kaanooni roop Article 14-18 (Right to Equality) hai, aur iske saath Article 39(c) (saman kaam ka saman vetan) aur Article 46 (kamzor vargon ke hith) DPSP mein hain. Isliye ye sirf DPSP ya Fundamental Duties ka hissa nahi, Preamble ka vaada hai. Exam point: Equality of status and opportunity = Preamble mein (aur uska kanooni vistaar Article 14-18 mein).

qe: The term 'Republic' was borrowed from the constitution of?
qh: 'गणराज्य' शब्द किस देश के संविधान से लिया गया था?
e: Preamble ka 'Republic' shabd France ke samvidhan se prerit (inspired) maana jaata hai - wahan se 'ganrajya' (republic) ka vichar aur uske saath 'Liberty, Equality, Fraternity' ka naara dono aaye. Lekin saavdhan rahe: Preamble ka 'We, the People' wala dhancha USA se, DPSP Ireland se, federation Canada se, aur samvidhan ki bhasha-shaili Australia se li gayi. Germany, Japan aur USA ke samvidhanon ka 'Republic' ke vishay mein aisa seedha srot nahi maana jaata. Exam point: Republic = France; We the People = USA; DPSP = Ireland; Federation = Canada; bhasha-shaili = Australia.

qe: Which part of the Preamble highlights the 'Dignity of the Individual'?
qh: प्रस्तावना का कौन सा भाग 'व्यक्ति की गरिमा' पर प्रकाश डालता है?
e: Preamble ke 'Fraternity' (bandhutva) ka saath ka hissa hi 'Dignity of the Individual' aur 'Unity/Integrity of Nation' ko darshata hai. Iska arth hai ki samvidhan sirf vyakti ke adhikar ya rashtra ki shakti ki baat nahi karta, balki dono ke beech santulan (balance) chahta hai - vyakti ka samman (dignity) aur rashtra ki ekta dono surakshit rahein. Isi liye samvidhan mein Fundamental Rights (vyakti ke adhikar) ke saath Fundamental Duties (rashtra ke prati kartavya) aur Article 51A bhi rakhe gaye hain. Exam point: Dignity of the Individual = Fraternity ka hissa (Liberty/Equality/Justice nahi).

qe: Economic Justice as one of the objectives of the Constitution is provided in?
qh: संविधान के उद्देश्यों में से एक के रूप में आर्थिक न्याय कहाँ प्रदान किया गया है?
e: Preamble ke hisaab se 'Economic Justice' samvidhan ke saath-saath DPSP (Directive Principles of State Policy) mein bhi diya gaya hai - Article 39 (aay aur sampatti ka saman vitaran), Article 39(c) (saman kaam ka saman vetan), Article 41 (kaam, shiksha, madad), Article 43 (khet-mazdoor ki sthiti) jaise nirdesh aarthik nyay ke liye hain. Preamble mein ye keval vaada hai, DPSP mein ise paane ke nirdesh hain. Fundamental Rights mein economic justice ka vistrit roop nahi hai (sirf kuchh had tak), isliye sahi jawab 'Preamble & DPSP' hai. Exam point: Economic Justice = Preamble (vaada) + DPSP (nirdesh/upay).

qe: The Preamble is an instrument of:
qh: प्रस्तावना किसका एक साधन है?
e: Preamble samvidhan ki vyakhya (interpretation) ka ek saadhan (instrument) hai - isi ke aadhar par court samvidhan ke anshon ke arth tay karti hai, khaas kar jab do arth sambhav (possible) hon. Ye vidhaayik (legislative) shakti ka srot nahi, na hi nirikshan (governance) ya judicial review ka aadhar; wo sab samvidhan ke alag-alag anshon (Article 245, 32, 226) se aate hain. Isi liye Preamble ko 'non-justiciable aid to interpretation' kaha jaata hai. Exam point: Preamble = instrument of interpretation (samvidhan ki vyakhya ka saadhan), shakti ya adhikar ka srot nahi.

qe: Who drafted the 'Objective Resolution'?
qh: 'उद्देश्य प्रस्ताव' किसने तैयार किया था?
e: Objective Resolution' ko Jawaharlal Nehru ne samvidhan sabha mein prastut kiya tha (13 December 1946) aur 22 January 1947 ko sweekar kiya gaya; yahi aage Preamble ban gaya. B.N. Rau samvidhanik salahkar (Constitutional Adviser) the, Motilal Nehru ne 1928 mein 'Nehru Report' di thi (alag dastaavez), aur B.R. Ambedkar Drafting Committee ke adhyaksh the. Isliye prashn ke choices mein Jawaharlal Nehru hi sahi hain. Exam point: Objective Resolution = Jawaharlal Nehru (13 Dec 1946, sweekrit 22 Jan 1947) = Preamble ki neev.

qe: The phrase 'Equality before law' is a part of 'Equality' mentioned in Preamble. True or False?
qh: 'कानून के समक्ष समानता' प्रस्तावना में वर्णित 'समानता' का हिस्सा है। सही या गलत?
e: 'Equality before law' (kanoon ke samaksh sab saman) samvidhan ke Article 14 mein hai aur ye Preamble ke 'Equality of status and opportunity' wale vaade ka ek ahem hissa hai. Isi tarah Article 15 (bhedbhav par rok), Article 16 (naukri mein barabari) aur Article 17 (chhuachhoot ka ant) Preamble ki samanata ko kaanooni roop dete hain. Isliye ye kathan sahi (true) hai ki 'Equality before law' Preamble wale Equality ka ek hissa hai - lekin strict kanooni roop Article 14 mein milta hai, na ki Justice ya Liberty ke andar. Exam point: Equality before law = Article 14 = Preamble ke Equality vaade ka kaanooni roop.

qe: Does the Preamble of India start with the same words as the US Constitution?
qh: क्या भारत की प्रस्तावना अमेरिकी संविधान के समान शब्दों से शुरू होती है?
e: Haan, bharat ke Preamble ki shuruaat un hi shabdon se hoti hai jo America ke samvidhan mein hain - 'We, the People of India' (USA: 'We the People of the United States'). Isi bhasha-shaili (phrase/style) ke karan kaha jaata hai ki Preamble ka dhancha USA se liya gaya hai, lekin uske baad ke aadarsh alag-alag deshon se aaye: justice - Russian, liberty-equality-fraternity - French, DPSP - Irish. Isliye sirf 'We the People' wale shabd USA se aaye hain, poora Preamble nahi. Exam point: 'We the People' (opening words) = USA; baaki shabd = French + Russian + Irish.

qe: The words 'Socialist' and 'Secular' were not in the original Preamble. True or False?
qh: 'समाजवादी' और 'धर्मनिरपेक्ष' शब्द मूल प्रस्तावना में नहीं थे। सही या गलत?
e: Ye kathan sahi hai - 1950 mein jab samvidhan lagu hua tab Preamble mein 'Socialist' aur 'Secular' shabd nahi the. Ye dono shabd 42nd samvidhan sanshodhan (1976) dwara jode gaye, saath hi 'Integrity' shabd bhi. 'Only socialist was there' ya 'only secular was there' - dono galat hain kyunki 1950 mein dono nahi the. Exam point: 1950 mein Preamble = 'Sovereign Democratic Republic'; 'Socialist' aur 'Secular' 1976 se (42nd sanshodhan se) jode gaye.

qe: The Preamble is 'Non-Justiciable'. What does this mean?
qh: प्रस्तावना 'गैर-न्यायोचित' है। इसका क्या अर्थ है?
o: It is not enforceable in courts (अदालतों में लागू नहीं)
It is not a part of law
e: Preamble ke 'Non-Justiciable' hone ka matlab hai ki ye adaalaton (courts) mein lagu (enforce) nahi kiya ja sakta - matlab koi bhi vyakti iske aadhar par muqadma nahi kar sakta aur court iske aadhar par kisi ko adesh nahi de sakti. Haan, ye samvidhan ka hissa hai aur samvidhan ki vyakhya mein upyog hota hai. Isliye 'it is supreme power', 'it cannot be amended' ya 'it is not a part of law' - teeno galat hain. Exam point: Non-justiciable = adalaton mein lagu nahi (sirf vyakhya mein upyogi).

qe: Who proposed the 'Objective Resolution' in the Constituent Assembly?
qh: संविधान सभा में 'उद्देश्य प्रस्ताव' किसने प्रस्तुत किया?
e: 'Objective Resolution' ko samvidhan sabha mein Jawaharlal Nehru ne prastut kiya tha (13 December 1946). Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Drafting Committee ke adhyaksh the, Dr. Rajendra Prasad samvidhan sabha ke sadachiv (President) the, aur Sardar Patel vibhinn samitiyon (Committees) ke adhyaksh the. Isliye prashn ka sahi jawab Jawaharlal Nehru hi hai, chahe sawaal 'proposed' ka ho ya 'drafted' ka - dono bayan unhi par lagu hote hain. Exam point: Objective Resolution = Jawaharlal Nehru (13 December 1946); Dana ke saath 22 January 1947 ko sweekrit.

qe: What is the ultimate source of authority according to the Preamble?
qh: प्रस्तावना के अनुसार अधिकार का अंतिम स्रोत क्या है?
o: The People of India (भारत की जनता)
e: Preamble ke anusaar sarvochch satta (ultimate source of authority) 'We, the People of India' - matlab bharat ki janata hai. Supreme Court, President aur Parliament sabhi satta ke upyogkarta hain, lekin satta ka asli srot janata hai; isi liye chunavon mein janata unhe badal sakti hai aur samvidhan ke bhi janata hi 'de diya' (give to ourselves) kaha gaya. Yahi soch 'popular sovereignty' (janatasatta) kehlati hai, aur bharat ke loktantra ka mool aadhaar hai. Exam point: ultimate source of authority = The People of India (popular sovereignty); baaki sab sirf satta ke upyogkarta (agents) hain.

qe: The term 'Republic' in our Preamble indicates that:
qh: हमारी प्रस्तावना में 'गणराज्य' शब्द इंगित करता है कि:
o: Head of state is elected (राज्य का प्रमुख निर्वाचित है)
e: Preamble ka 'Republic' shabd batata hai ki bharat ka rashtra-pramukh (head of state) nirvachit (elected) hoga, na ki raajvansh (hereditary) se. Isi liye bharat ke Rashtrapati ka chunav Electoral College (Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha aur Vidhan Sabhas ke nirvachit sadasy) dwara hota hai aur unka kaaryakal 5 saal ka hota hai. Britain jaisa raajvanshiya shasan (monarchy) iska vikalp hai - wahan satta vansh se chalti hai; isliye bharat 'Republic' hai. Exam point: Republic = rashtra-pramukh nirvachit (elected head of state), na ki vanshagat (hereditary).

qe: How many types of 'Liberty' are mentioned in the Preamble?
qh: प्रस्तावना में कितने प्रकार की 'स्वतंत्रता' का उल्लेख है?
e: Preamble mein 'Liberty' ke 5 roop ginaaye gaye hain - Liberty of thought (soch), expression (abhivyakti), belief (vishwas), faith (dharm-vishwas) aur worship (pooja). Ye paanchon mil kar vyakti ki aantarik aur bahri swatantrata ko darshate hain: andar ki (thought, belief, faith) aur bahar ki (expression, worship). Isi tarah samvidhan ke Article 19 (1) (a) mein expression ki swatantrata aur Article 25-28 mein dharmik swatantrata ka vistaar milta hai. Isliye 6, 4 ya 3 galat hain; sahi sankhya 5 hai. Exam point: Preamble mein Liberty ke 5 roop - thought, expression, belief, faith, worship.

qe: Which of the following is NOT a part of the Preamble?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन प्रस्तावना का हिस्सा नहीं है?
e: Preamble mein 'Federal' (sangh) shabd nahi hai. Preamble mein maujood hain - Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, Republic, aur adarshon mein Justice (social, economic, political), Liberty, Equality aur Fraternity. 'Federal' shabd ki jhalak samvidhan ke Article 1 (Union of States) aur 7th Schedule (shaktiyon ka vitaran) se milti hai, aur isi liye bharat ko 'quasi-federal' (ardh-sanghiya) kaha jaata hai. Isliye Preamble mein federal ka na hona hi sahi hai. Exam point: Preamble mein keywords sirf 5 hain (Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, Republic) - Federal unmein nahi hai.

qe: In which case did SC say 'Preamble is the horoscope of our constitution'?
qh: किस मामले में SC ने कहा कि 'प्रस्तावना हमारे संविधान की जन्मकुंडली है'?
e: Preamble ko 'horoscope of our constitution' kehne wala bayan K.M. Munshi ka hai, jo samvidhan sabha ke sadasya the. Isse pehle Golaknath (1967) mein Justice Hidayatullah ne Preamble ko 'soul' kaha tha, aur L.I.C. of India Case (1995) mein aay-kar aur adhikar ke mudde the (Preamble ka horoscope wala bayan wahan nahi hua). A.K. Gopalan case (1950) Mein Article 21 aur nirikshan ka vishay tha. Isliye 'K.M. Munshi (statement)' hi sahi jawab hai. Exam point: Horoscope = K.M. Munshi ka bayan (faisla nahi); Soul = Justice Hidayatullah (Golaknath, 1967).

qe: Justice, Liberty, Equality, and Fraternity - which one is mentioned first?
qh: न्याय, स्वतंत्रता, समानता और बंधुत्व - किसका उल्लेख सबसे पहले है?
e: Preamble mein 'Justice' sabse pehle aata hai - poora kram hai 'Justice, social, economic and political; Liberty of thought, expression, belief, faith and worship; Equality of status and opportunity; and Fraternity...' Isliye Justice pehla, phir Liberty, phir Equality aur ant mein Fraternity aata hai. Is kram ka matlab hai ki nyay (justice) sabse pehle zaroori hai kyunki bina nyay ke swatantrata ka koi arth nahi, aur bina swatantrata ke samanata nahi, aur bina samanata ke bandhutva nahi. Exam point: Preamble mein adarshon ka kram - Justice > Liberty > Equality > Fraternity (Justice pehla, Fraternity aakhri).
